meta.title: 英语语法知识图谱
meta.description: 从零基础到六级的英语语法知识体系，树杈式分类。覆盖初中(junior)、高中(senior)、四级(cet4)、六级(cet6)全部核心语法知识点。

levelDescription.junior: 初中水平：be动词、基本时态、基本句型、词法基础
levelDescription.senior: 高中水平：从句体系、非谓语动词、虚拟语气、特殊句式
levelDescription.cet4: 四级水平：高频搭配、长难句结构、进阶从句
levelDescription.cet6: 六级水平：高级虚拟、独立主格、复杂句式分析

be动词 (be verb).name: be动词的三种形式：am/is/are
be动词 (be verb).plainLanguage: be动词就是英语里的'是'，它有三种形式：I搭配am，他/她/它搭配is，你/我们/他们搭配are。口诀：I用am，you用are，is跟着他她它，复数全用are。
rules: I + am（第一人称单数）
You + are（第二人称单复数）
He/She/It + is（第三人称单数）
We/They + are（复数）

examples.en: I am a student.
examples.cn: 我是一名学生。

examples.en: She is a teacher.
examples.cn: 她是一名老师。

examples.en: They are my friends.
examples.cn: 他们是我的朋友。

examples.en: You are very kind.
examples.cn: 你真好。

examples.en: It is a beautiful day.
examples.cn: 今天天气真好。

commonMistakes.wrong: He are a student.
commonMistakes.correct: He is a student.
commonMistakes.reason: he是第三人称单数，be动词用is不能用are

commonMistakes.wrong: I is happy.
commonMistakes.correct: I am happy.
commonMistakes.reason: 第一人称I只能搭配am，不能用is

commonMistakes.wrong: They is my classmates.
commonMistakes.correct: They are my classmates.
commonMistakes.reason: they是复数，be动词要用are

be动词 (be verb).tips: 记住口诀：I用am，you用are，is跟着他她它，单数is复数are

be动词 (be verb).name: be动词的否定和疑问形式
be动词 (be verb).plainLanguage: be动词变否定就是在它后面加not，而且not可以缩写成n't（比如is not = isn't）。变疑问句就把be动词提到主语前面，就像把'他是学生'变成'他是学生吗'一样。
rules: 否定句：主语 + be + not + ...（not可缩写为n't）
一般疑问句：Be + 主语 + ...？（用Yes/No回答）
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + be + 主语 + ...？
肯定回答：Yes, 主语 + be. 否定回答：No, 主语 + be + not.

examples.en: She is not (isn't) at home.
examples.cn: 她不在家。

examples.en: Are you a doctor? - Yes, I am.
examples.cn: 你是医生吗？——是的，我是。

examples.en: Is he your brother? - No, he isn't.
examples.cn: 他是你兄弟吗？——不，他不是。

examples.en: Where are they now?
examples.cn: 他们现在在哪里？

examples.en: What is this?
examples.cn: 这是什么？

commonMistakes.wrong: Is she a nurse? - Yes, she's.
commonMistakes.correct: Is she a nurse? - Yes, she is.
commonMistakes.reason: 肯定回答不能用缩写she's，必须用完整形式she is

commonMistakes.wrong: Are they happy? - No, they don't.
commonMistakes.correct: Are they happy? - No, they aren't.
commonMistakes.reason: be动词的疑问句回答要用be动词，不能用do/don't

commonMistakes.wrong: She isn't not at home.
commonMistakes.correct: She isn't at home.
commonMistakes.reason: 双重否定错误，isn't已经包含了not，不能再加not

be动词 (be verb).tips: be动词变否定加not，变疑问提句首。回答时be动词要跟主语走，肯定不缩写，否定可缩写。

be动词 (be verb).name: be动词的缩写形式
be动词 (be verb).plainLanguage: 英语说话时常把be动词缩短来念，就像中文口语里'不要'说成'别'。I am缩成I'm，you are缩成you're，he is缩成he's，they are缩成they're。注意：肯定回答不能缩写！
rules: I am → I'm
you are → you're
he/she/it is → he's/she's/it's
we/they are → we're/they're
is not → isn't, are not → aren't
注意：肯定简短回答不能用缩写（如Yes, I am. 不能写Yes, I'm.）

examples.en: I'm twelve years old.
examples.cn: 我十二岁了。

examples.en: She's from Beijing.
examples.cn: 她来自北京。

examples.en: They're playing soccer.
examples.cn: 他们正在踢足球。

examples.en: It's a rainy day.
examples.cn: 今天下雨。

examples.en: We aren't ready yet.
examples.cn: 我们还没准备好。

commonMistakes.wrong: Yes, I'm.
commonMistakes.correct: Yes, I am.
commonMistakes.reason: 肯定简短回答不能缩写，必须用完整形式

commonMistakes.wrong: Where's you from?
commonMistakes.correct: Where are you from?
commonMistakes.reason: you搭配are，不能用is的缩写's

commonMistakes.wrong: It's a cat. It's tail is long.
commonMistakes.correct: It's a cat. Its tail is long.
commonMistakes.reason: it's = it is，而its是'它的'，两者含义不同

be动词 (be verb).tips: 缩写口诀：I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're。但记住：肯定回答别缩写！it's和its别搞混！

there be句型 (there be structure).name: there be句型的基本用法
there be句型 (there be structure).plainLanguage: there be句型就是'某地有某物'。比如'桌上有本书'就是There is a book on the desk。它和have不同：there be表示'存在'（那里有什么），have表示'拥有'（我有什么）。
rules: 结构：There + be + 主语 + 地点/时间状语
含义：表示'某地/某时有某物/人'
be动词单复数取决于后面的主语（第一个主语）
there be与have的区别：there be表'存在'，have表'拥有'
否定：There isn't/aren't...；疑问：Is/Are there...?

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
examples.cn: 桌上有本书。

examples.en: There are many students in the classroom.
examples.cn: 教室里有很多学生。

examples.en: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
examples.cn: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

examples.en: Are there any apples on the tree?
examples.cn: 树上有苹果吗？

examples.en: There was a meeting yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天有个会议。

commonMistakes.wrong: There have a book on the desk.
commonMistakes.correct: There is a book on the desk.
commonMistakes.reason: 表示'存在'要用there be，不能用there have

commonMistakes.wrong: There is two cats in the room.
commonMistakes.correct: There are two cats in the room.
commonMistakes.reason: 主语two cats是复数，be动词要用are

commonMistakes.wrong: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
commonMistakes.correct: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
commonMistakes.reason: 此处正确——就近原则，be动词取决于最近的第一个主语a book（单数），所以用is

there be句型 (there be structure).tips: there be表'存在有'，have表'拥有有'。判断方法：能说'在什么地方有'用there be，能说'谁拥有'用have。

there be句型 (there be structure).name: there be的就近原则
there be句型 (there be structure).plainLanguage: 当there be后面跟着多个东西时，be动词跟最近的那个走，这叫'就近原则'。比如'桌上有本书和两支笔'，最近的是a book（单数），所以用is。就像排队，只看第一个人的数量。
rules: 当有多个主语并列时，be动词与最近的那个主语保持一致
There is + 单数 + and + 复数
There are + 复数 + and + 单数
这个原则也适用于here开头的句子

examples.en: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
examples.cn: 桌上有一本书和两支笔。

examples.en: There are two pens and a book on the desk.
examples.cn: 桌上有两支笔和一本书。

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
examples.cn: 公交车来了。

examples.en: There is a man and three women waiting outside.
examples.cn: 外面有一个男人和三个女人在等。

examples.en: There are three women and a man waiting outside.
examples.cn: 外面有三个女人和一个男人在等。

commonMistakes.wrong: There are a book and two pens on the desk.
commonMistakes.correct: There is a book and two pens on the desk.
commonMistakes.reason: 就近原则：最近的a book是单数，be动词用is

commonMistakes.wrong: There is two pens and a book on the desk.
commonMistakes.correct: There are two pens and a book on the desk.
commonMistakes.reason: 就近原则：最近的two pens是复数，be动词用are

there be句型 (there be structure).tips: 就近原则就是'谁离be动词最近就跟谁走'。把最近的名词数量记住就行。

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).name: 语法一致原则
主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).plainLanguage: 语法一致就是主语是单数，动词就用单数形式；主语是复数，动词就用复数形式。这是最基本的规则——主语啥样，动词就啥样。
rules: 单数主语 + 单数动词
复数主语 + 复数动词
不可数名词作主语，动词用单数
each/every + 单数名词作主语，动词用单数

examples.en: The boy plays football every day.
examples.cn: 那个男孩每天踢足球。

examples.en: The boys play football every day.
examples.cn: 那些男孩每天踢足球。

examples.en: Water is important for life.
examples.cn: 水对生命很重要。

examples.en: Every student has a dictionary.
examples.cn: 每个学生都有一本字典。

examples.en: Each of the answers is correct.
examples.cn: 每个答案都是正确的。

commonMistakes.wrong: The water are clean.
commonMistakes.correct: The water is clean.
commonMistakes.reason: water是不可数名词，谓语动词用单数is

commonMistakes.wrong: Each student have a book.
commonMistakes.correct: Each student has a book.
commonMistakes.reason: each修饰的主语按单数处理，动词用has

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).tips: 语法一致最简单：单数主语配单数动词，复数主语配复数动词。不可数名词永远当单数。

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).name: 意义一致原则
主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).plainLanguage: 有时主语长得像复数但意思上是单数，或者长得像单数但意思上是复数。这时要看意思，不看形式。比如family当'一家人'讲时是复数，当'家庭'讲时是单数。
rules: 集体名词（family/team/class等）看成一个整体用单数，指成员用复数
表示时间/距离/金钱的复数名词看作一个整体，用单数
news/physics/mathematics等以-s结尾的词，实际是单数
people/police/cattle等词，永远用复数

examples.en: My family is very large.
examples.cn: 我的家庭很大。（看成一个整体）

examples.en: My family are watching TV.
examples.cn: 我的家人在看电视。（指成员）

examples.en: Ten years is a long time.
examples.cn: 十年是很长的时间。

examples.en: The news is exciting.
examples.cn: 这个消息很令人兴奋。

examples.en: The police are looking for the thief.
examples.cn: 警察正在寻找小偷。

commonMistakes.wrong: The news are good.
commonMistakes.correct: The news is good.
commonMistakes.reason: news虽然以s结尾，但实际是单数名词

commonMistakes.wrong: Three miles are a long way to walk.
commonMistakes.correct: Three miles is a long way to walk.
commonMistakes.reason: 表示距离的复数看作一个整体，用单数

commonMistakes.wrong: The police is coming.
commonMistakes.correct: The police are coming.
commonMistakes.reason: police永远用复数

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).tips: 看意思不看形式：family整体单数、成员复数；news/math永远单数；people/police永远复数。

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).name: 就近原则
主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).plainLanguage: 当主语用or（或者）、nor（也不）、not only...but also（不仅...而且）、either...or（要么...要么）连接时，动词跟最近的主语走。谁离动词最近，就跟谁保持一致。
rules: A or B + 动词（动词与B一致）
Either A or B + 动词（动词与B一致）
Neither A nor B + 动词（动词与B一致）
Not only A but also B + 动词（动词与B一致）

examples.en: You or he is wrong.
examples.cn: 你或者他错了。（跟he走，用is）

examples.en: He or I am responsible for it.
examples.cn: 他或者我对此负责。（跟I走，用am）

examples.en: Neither you nor he is right.
examples.cn: 你和他都不对。

examples.en: Either Tom or his brothers are coming.
examples.cn: 要么汤姆要么他兄弟们要来。

examples.en: Not only the teacher but also the students were happy.
examples.cn: 不仅老师而且学生们都很高兴。

commonMistakes.wrong: You or he are wrong.
commonMistakes.correct: You or he is wrong.
commonMistakes.reason: 就近原则：he离动词最近，是单数，所以用is

commonMistakes.wrong: Neither Tom nor his brothers is coming.
commonMistakes.correct: Neither Tom nor his brothers are coming.
commonMistakes.reason: 就近原则：his brothers离动词最近，是复数，所以用are

主谓一致 (subject-verb agreement).tips: or/nor/either...or/neither...nor/not only...but also，找最近的那个主语，跟它走。

基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).name: 五大基本句型
基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).plainLanguage: 英语句子就像搭积木，基本就五种搭法：1.主+谓（他跑了）；2.主+谓+宾（他打球）；3.主+谓+双宾（他给我一本书）；4.主+谓+宾+宾补（他叫我老师）；5.主+系+表（他是老师）。所有复杂句子都是这五种基本句型扩展来的。
rules: S + V（主+谓）：The sun rises.
S + V + O（主+谓+宾）：I love you.
S + V + IO + DO（主+谓+间宾+直宾）：She gave me a book.
S + V + O + OC（主+谓+宾+宾补）：We call him Tom.
S + V + P（主+系+表）：She is beautiful.

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.
examples.cn: 太阳从东方升起。（S+V）

examples.en: I love English.
examples.cn: 我喜欢英语。（S+V+O）

examples.en: She gave me a book.
examples.cn: 她给了我一本书。（S+V+IO+DO）

examples.en: We call him Tom.
examples.cn: 我们叫他汤姆。（S+V+O+OC）

examples.en: The food smells good.
examples.cn: 食物闻起来很好。（S+V+P）

commonMistakes.wrong: She gave a book me.
commonMistakes.correct: She gave me a book.
commonMistakes.reason: 双宾语中，人（间接宾语）在前，物（直接宾语）在后；若物在前需加to/for：She gave a book to me.

commonMistakes.wrong: We call him to Tom.
commonMistakes.correct: We call him Tom.
commonMistakes.reason: 宾补直接放在宾语后，不需要加介词

基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).tips: 五大句型口诀：一主一谓最简单，主谓宾是三件套，双宾给人再给物，宾补补充说明宾，系表相连说明主。

基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).name: 简单句、并列句与复合句
基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).plainLanguage: 简单句就是一套主谓结构的句子（比如'我爱英语'）；并列句是用and/but/or等把两个简单句连起来（比如'我爱英语但讨厌数学'）；复合句是句子里面套句子，用一个从句当成分（比如'我知道你喜欢英语'里的'你喜欢英语'是个从句）。
rules: 简单句：只有一套主谓结构
并列句：用并列连词（and/but/or/so/for等）连接两个或多个分句
复合句：包含一个主句和一个或多个从句
并列复合句：既有并列又有从属关系

examples.en: I like English.
examples.cn: 我喜欢英语。（简单句）

examples.en: I like English, but I don't like math.
examples.cn: 我喜欢英语，但我不喜欢数学。（并列句）

examples.en: I know that you like English.
examples.cn: 我知道你喜欢英语。（复合句）

examples.en: I like English, and I know that you like it too.
examples.cn: 我喜欢英语，而且我知道你也喜欢。（并列复合句）

examples.en: When it rains, I stay at home.
examples.cn: 下雨的时候，我待在家里。（复合句）

commonMistakes.wrong: Because it was raining, so I stayed at home.
commonMistakes.correct: Because it was raining, I stayed at home.
commonMistakes.reason: 英语中because和so不能同时使用，选一个即可

commonMistakes.wrong: Although he is tired, but he keeps working.
commonMistakes.correct: Although he is tired, he keeps working.
commonMistakes.reason: although和but不能同时使用，中文可以说'虽然...但是...'，英语只能用一个

基本句型 (basic sentence patterns).tips: 中文'因为...所以...'/'虽然...但是...'在英语中只能保留一个连词！这是最容易犯的中式英语错误。

it的用法 (Usage of it).name: it的用法：形式主语、形式宾语与强调用法
it的用法 (Usage of it).plainLanguage: it这个小词特别忙，除了指代事物，还能当'替身'。当真正的主语或宾语太长（比如to do或不定式从句），就请it先顶上做形式主语/形式宾语。它还能用来强调，'就是他打了窗户'就是It was he that broke the window。
rules: 形式主语：It is/was + adj/n + to do / that从句（真正主语后移）
形式宾语：主语 + 谓语 + it + adj/n + to do / that从句（常见于find/make/think/feel后）
强调句：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他
指代时间/天气/距离/温度：It is raining. It is 8 o'clock. It is far.
指代上文提到的事物或婴儿/未知性别的人
判断强调句：去掉It is/was和that后句子仍完整

examples.en: It is important to learn English well.
examples.cn: 学好英语很重要。（it作形式主语，to learn...是真正主语）

examples.en: It is a pity that you missed the party.
examples.cn: 真遗憾你错过了聚会。（it作形式主语，that从句是真正主语）

examples.en: I find it difficult to understand him.
examples.cn: 我发现理解他很难。（it作形式宾语，to understand...是真正宾语）

examples.en: He made it clear that he would not come.
examples.cn: 他明确表示不会来。（it作形式宾语）

examples.en: It was in the park that I met her.
examples.cn: 我就是在公园遇到她的。（强调句，强调地点）

examples.en: It is two miles from here to the station.
examples.cn: 从这里到车站有两英里。（指代距离）

commonMistakes.wrong: That you missed the party is a pity.
commonMistakes.correct: It is a pity that you missed the party.
commonMistakes.reason: that从句作主语太头重脚轻，通常用it作形式主语，把that从句后移

commonMistakes.wrong: I find that difficult to understand him.
commonMistakes.correct: I find it difficult to understand him.
commonMistakes.reason: 宾补结构中要用it作形式宾语，不能用that，真正宾语是to understand him

commonMistakes.wrong: It was yesterday when I met her.
commonMistakes.correct: It was yesterday that I met her.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调句用that连接，不能用when（when是定语从句/状语从句引导词）

it的用法 (Usage of it).tips: 形式主语/宾语：真正主语/宾语太长（to do/that从句），用it先顶上。强调句：It is/was + 强调部分 + that + 剩余。去掉It...that句子仍通顺=强调句！

直接引语与间接引语 (Direct & Indirect Speech).name: 直接引语与间接引语
直接引语与间接引语 (Direct & Indirect Speech).plainLanguage: 直接引语就是把别人的话原封不动引号引出来；间接引语是用自己的话转述别人的话。转述时要注意：时态往回退一步（现在变过去），人称要跟着变，时间和地点词也要调整。
rules: 直接引语：He said, 'I am busy.'（引号内原话）
间接引语：He said that he was busy.（转述，that可省）
时态变化：一般现在→一般过去，现在进行→过去进行，现在完成→过去完成，一般过去→过去完成
人称变化：I→he/she，we→they，my→his/her（按转述者视角调整）
时间/地点变化：now→then，today→that day，yesterday→the day before，here→there，tomorrow→the next day
疑问句转述：用if/whether（一般疑问）或保留疑问词（特殊疑问），语序变陈述语序
祈使句转述：tell/ask sb to do sth

examples.en: She said, 'I like reading.' → She said (that) she liked reading.
examples.cn: 她说：'我喜欢阅读。'→她说她喜欢阅读。

examples.en: He said, 'I will come tomorrow.' → He said he would come the next day.
examples.cn: 他说：'我明天来。'→他说他第二天来。

examples.en: She asked me, 'Do you know the answer?' → She asked me if I knew the answer.
examples.cn: 她问我：'你知道答案吗？'→她问我是不是知道答案。

examples.en: He asked, 'Where is the station?' → He asked where the station was.
examples.cn: 他问：'车站在哪？'→他问车站在哪。

examples.en: 'Don't be late,' the teacher said. → The teacher told us not to be late.
examples.cn: '别迟到，'老师说。→老师叫我们别迟到。

commonMistakes.wrong: He said that he is busy.
commonMistakes.correct: He said that he was busy.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句said是过去时，从句时态要往回退，is要变成was

commonMistakes.wrong: She asked me if do I know the answer.
commonMistakes.correct: She asked me if I knew the answer.
commonMistakes.reason: 间接引语中疑问句要变陈述语序（主语在前），且时态退一步knew

commonMistakes.wrong: He said he would come today.
commonMistakes.correct: He said he would come that day.
commonMistakes.reason: 转述时today要变成that day（如果转述时间和说话时间不同）

直接引语与间接引语 (Direct & Indirect Speech).tips: 间接引语三变：时态退一步（is→was, will→would）、人称跟着变（I→he/she）、时间地点词要调（now→then, here→there）。疑问句变陈述语序！

祈使句 (Imperative Sentence).name: 祈使句
祈使句 (Imperative Sentence).plainLanguage: 祈使句就是命令、请求或建议的句子，主语you通常省略，直接用动词原形开头。比如'打开门'就是Open the door。否定形式加Don't：Don't open the door。礼貌点就加please。
rules: 肯定形式：动词原形开头（主语you省略）
否定形式：Don't / Never + 动词原形
Let's + 动词原形：表示建议（Let's go!）
Please + 动词原形：表礼貌请求（Please sit down.）
Do/Always + 动词原形：加强语气（Do be careful!）
No + 动名词/名词：表示禁止（No smoking!）

examples.en: Open the door, please.
examples.cn: 请开门。

examples.en: Don't be late for school.
examples.cn: 上学别迟到。

examples.en: Let's go for a walk.
examples.cn: 我们去散步吧。

examples.en: Never give up!
examples.cn: 永远不要放弃！

examples.en: Be quiet, everyone!
examples.cn: 大家安静！

commonMistakes.wrong: Opens the door.
commonMistakes.correct: Open the door.
commonMistakes.reason: 祈使句用动词原形Open，不能用第三人称单数Opens

commonMistakes.wrong: Don't to be late.
commonMistakes.correct: Don't be late.
commonMistakes.reason: Don't后接动词原形be，不能加to

commonMistakes.wrong: Please you open the door.
commonMistakes.correct: Please open the door.
commonMistakes.reason: 祈使句主语you通常省略，不说you

祈使句 (Imperative Sentence).tips: 祈使句=动词原形开头，主语you省掉。否定Don't+原形。礼貌加please，建议用Let's，禁止用No+doing（No smoking!）。

一般现在时 (Simple Present).name: 一般现在时的基本用法
一般现在时 (Simple Present).plainLanguage: 一般现在时就是描述'经常做的事、客观事实、当前状态'。比如'我每天上学'、'地球是圆的'、'他很高'。动词用原形，但第三人称单数（他/她/它）要加s。
rules: 表示经常性或习惯性的动作（常搭配always/usually/often/every day等）
表示客观真理和事实
表示现在的状态
第三人称单数作主语时，动词加s/es
否定：don't/doesn't + 动词原形；疑问：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形

examples.en: I go to school every day.
examples.cn: 我每天上学。

examples.en: The earth goes around the sun.
examples.cn: 地球绕着太阳转。

examples.en: She likes music.
examples.cn: 她喜欢音乐。

examples.en: He doesn't speak Chinese.
examples.cn: 他不会说中文。

examples.en: Do you often play basketball?
examples.cn: 你经常打篮球吗？

commonMistakes.wrong: He go to school every day.
commonMistakes.correct: He goes to school every day.
commonMistakes.reason: he是第三人称单数，动词go要加es变成goes

commonMistakes.wrong: She doesn't likes music.
commonMistakes.correct: She doesn't like music.
commonMistakes.reason: doesn't后面用动词原形，不能再加s

commonMistakes.wrong: Do she like music?
commonMistakes.correct: Does she like music?
commonMistakes.reason: she是第三人称单数，疑问句用Does提问

一般现在时 (Simple Present).tips: 一般现在时用原形，三单加s/es。否定加don't/doesn't，后面接原形！疑问用Do/Does。

一般现在时 (Simple Present).name: 第三人称单数变化规则
一般现在时 (Simple Present).plainLanguage: 当主语是'他/她/它'或单个的人/物时，动词要加s或es。规则是：一般加s，以s/x/ch/sh/o结尾加es，辅音字母+y结尾把y变i加es。记住口诀就不难了。
rules: 一般情况：直接加s（play→plays, like→likes）
以s/x/sh/ch/o结尾：加es（go→goes, watch→watches, wash→washes, fix→fixes）
辅音字母+y结尾：变y为i加es（study→studies, carry→carries）
元音字母+y结尾：直接加s（play→plays, buy→buys）
特殊变化：have→has, be→is

examples.en: He plays the piano well.
examples.cn: 他钢琴弹得好。

examples.en: She watches TV every evening.
examples.cn: 她每天晚上看电视。

examples.en: Tom studies hard.
examples.cn: 汤姆努力学习。

examples.en: It goes fast.
examples.cn: 它跑得很快。

examples.en: My mother has a car.
examples.cn: 我妈妈有一辆车。

commonMistakes.wrong: He watchs TV every day.
commonMistakes.correct: He watches TV every day.
commonMistakes.reason: 以ch结尾的动词，第三人称单数加es，不是加s

commonMistakes.wrong: She studys hard.
commonMistakes.correct: She studies hard.
commonMistakes.reason: 辅音字母+y结尾，要把y变i再加es

commonMistakes.wrong: He have a new bike.
commonMistakes.correct: He has a new bike.
commonMistakes.reason: have的第三人称单数形式是has，不是haves

一般现在时 (Simple Present).tips: 三单变化口诀：一般直接加s，s/x/ch/sh/o加es，辅音+y变i加es，have变has，be变is。

一般过去时 (Simple Past).name: 一般过去时的基本用法
一般过去时 (Simple Past).plainLanguage: 一般过去时就是描述'过去发生的事'，现在已经结束了。比如'我昨天去了北京'、'他去年很胖'。动词要变成过去式，经常搭配yesterday/last week/ago等时间词。
rules: 表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态
常搭配的时间状语：yesterday, last week, ... ago, in 2010等
动词用过去式（规则动词加ed，不规则动词单独记）
否定：did not (didn't) + 动词原形
疑问：Did + 主语 + 动词原形

examples.en: I went to Beijing yesterday.
examples.cn: 我昨天去了北京。

examples.en: She was very happy last night.
examples.cn: 她昨晚很开心。

examples.en: They didn't watch TV last night.
examples.cn: 他们昨晚没有看电视。

examples.en: Did you finish your homework?
examples.cn: 你完成作业了吗？

examples.en: He lived in Shanghai three years ago.
examples.cn: 三年前他住在上海。

commonMistakes.wrong: I go to Beijing yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: I went to Beijing yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 有yesterday这个过去时间标志，动词要用过去式went

commonMistakes.wrong: She didn't went to school.
commonMistakes.correct: She didn't go to school.
commonMistakes.reason: didn't后面用动词原形go，不能用过去式went

commonMistakes.wrong: Did he finished his homework?
commonMistakes.correct: Did he finish his homework?
commonMistakes.reason: Did提问时，动词用原形finish，不能再加ed

一般过去时 (Simple Past).tips: 过去时有过去式，否定加didn't接原形，疑问用Did接原形。记住：did一出，动词回原形！

一般过去时 (Simple Past).name: 动词过去式规则与不规则变化
一般过去时 (Simple Past).plainLanguage: 动词过去式分两种：规则和不规则。规则的就是加ed，比如play→played。但有很多常用动词是不规则的，得死记硬背，比如go→went, see→saw, eat→ate。这些不规则动词是考试必考的！
rules: 一般情况：直接加ed（work→worked, play→played）
以e结尾：只加d（like→liked, live→lived）
辅音+y结尾：变y为i加ed（study→studied）
重读闭音节结尾：双写末尾辅音字母加ed（stop→stopped, plan→planned）
不规则动词需单独记忆：go→went, see→saw, eat→ate, take→took, give→gave等

examples.en: They played soccer yesterday.
examples.cn: 他们昨天踢了足球。

examples.en: She liked the movie.
examples.cn: 她喜欢那部电影。

examples.en: He studied for the exam.
examples.cn: 他为考试做了准备。

examples.en: We stopped at the red light.
examples.cn: 我们在红灯前停了下来。

examples.en: I went to the park last Sunday.
examples.cn: 上周日我去了公园。

commonMistakes.wrong: He studyed hard yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: He studied hard yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 辅音字母+y结尾，y要变i加ed，不能直接加ed

commonMistakes.wrong: They stoped the car.
commonMistakes.correct: They stopped the car.
commonMistakes.reason: 重读闭音节结尾，要双写末尾辅音p再加ed

commonMistakes.wrong: I goed to school yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: I went to school yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: go是不规则动词，过去式是went，不是goed

一般过去时 (Simple Past).tips: 规则变化：加d/ed/双写+ed/变y为i+ed。不规则动词：背！背！背！常用的有go-went, see-saw, eat-ate, take-took, give-gave, get-got, come-came, buy-bought等。

一般将来时 (Simple Future).name: will与be going to的区别
一般将来时 (Simple Future).plainLanguage: 两者都表示将来，但有区别：will是'临时起意'或'预测'，比如'我来帮你吧'；be going to是'计划好了'或'有迹象要发生'，比如'我打算明天去北京'、'看那乌云，要下雨了'。
rules: will：表示临时决定、预测未来、意愿
be going to：表示已计划好的打算、根据目前迹象推测
will + 动词原形
be going to + 动词原形
be about to + 动词原形：表示马上就要发生的事

examples.en: I will help you with your homework.
examples.cn: 我来帮你做作业吧。（临时决定）

examples.en: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我打算明天去看奶奶。（计划好的）

examples.en: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
examples.cn: 看那些乌云！要下雨了。（有迹象）

examples.en: He will be twenty next year.
examples.cn: 他明年就二十岁了。（客观事实）

examples.en: The train is about to leave.
examples.cn: 火车马上就要开了。

commonMistakes.wrong: Look at the clouds! It will rain.
commonMistakes.correct: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
commonMistakes.reason: 有明确迹象（乌云），要用be going to而不是will

commonMistakes.wrong: I will going to visit my uncle.
commonMistakes.correct: I am going to visit my uncle.
commonMistakes.reason: be going to结构中be动词不能遗漏，且will和be going to不能同时用

一般将来时 (Simple Future).tips: 临时决定用will，计划打算用be going to，有迹象也用be going to，马上发生用be about to。

一般将来时 (Simple Future).name: 一般现在时和现在进行时表将来
一般将来时 (Simple Future).plainLanguage: 一般现在时可以表示'按时间表要发生的事'（比如火车时刻表、航班）；现在进行时可以表示'已经安排好的近期计划'（比如'我明天要走'用I'm leaving tomorrow）。这不是一般将来时的替代，而是特殊用法。
rules: 一般现在时表将来：用于时刻表、日程表等固定安排
现在进行时表将来：表示已安排好的近期计划，常搭配come/go/leave/arrive等动词
be to + 动词原形：表示官方计划或命令
be about to + 动词原形：表示马上发生

examples.en: The train leaves at 8:00 tomorrow morning.
examples.cn: 火车明天早上八点开。（时刻表）

examples.en: I'm leaving for Shanghai tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我明天要去上海。（已安排好）

examples.en: The president is to visit Japan next month.
examples.cn: 总统将于下月访问日本。（官方计划）

examples.en: The concert is about to begin.
examples.cn: 音乐会马上就要开始了。

examples.en: We are flying to Paris next week.
examples.cn: 我们下周飞往巴黎。

commonMistakes.wrong: The train will leave at 8:00 according to the timetable.
commonMistakes.correct: The train leaves at 8:00 according to the timetable.
commonMistakes.reason: 按时刻表发生的用一般现在时，不用will

commonMistakes.wrong: I leave for Shanghai tomorrow.
commonMistakes.correct: I am leaving for Shanghai tomorrow.
commonMistakes.reason: 个人计划安排用现在进行时，不用一般现在时（除非是官方时刻表）

一般将来时 (Simple Future).tips: 时刻表用一般现在时，个人计划用进行时。come/go/leave/arrive/fly这些'位移'动词最常这样用。

一般将来时 (Simple Future).name: 一般将来时的其他表达方式
一般将来时 (Simple Future).plainLanguage: 除了will和be going to，表达将来还有好几种方式。be about to表示'马上就要'；be to表示'计划/命令/注定'；shall用于第一人称正式场合；be due to表示'按时间表预计'。各有各的味道。
rules: be about to + 动词原形：马上就要发生（不接具体时间状语）
be to + 动词原形：表示计划、命令、注定要发生的事
shall + 动词原形：第一人称(I/we)的将来，正式用语
be due to + 动词原形：按时间表预计要发生的事
be on the point of + 动名词：正要做某事

examples.en: The plane is about to take off.
examples.cn: 飞机马上就要起飞了。

examples.en: The president is to visit Japan next month.
examples.cn: 总统将于下月访问日本。（计划）

examples.en: I shall return soon.
examples.cn: 我很快就会回来。（正式）

examples.en: The train is due to arrive at 8:00.
examples.cn: 火车预计八点到。

examples.en: I was on the point of leaving when the phone rang.
examples.cn: 我正要离开时电话响了。

commonMistakes.wrong: The plane is about to take off in five minutes.
commonMistakes.correct: The plane is about to take off.
commonMistakes.reason: be about to表示马上发生，不能和具体时间状语连用

commonMistakes.wrong: He is about to go tomorrow.
commonMistakes.correct: He is going to go tomorrow.
commonMistakes.reason: be about to不接将来的时间状语，有tomorrow时用be going to

一般将来时 (Simple Future).tips: be about to=马上（不带时间状语）；be to=计划/命令/注定；shall=第一人称正式将来；be due to=按时刻表预计。
relatedCategories: 一般现在时和现在进行时表将来

现在进行时 (Present Continuous).name: 现在进行时的基本用法
现在进行时 (Present Continuous).plainLanguage: 现在进行时就是'正在做的事'。比如'我正在吃饭'。结构是be + 动词ing。be动词跟主语走（am/is/are），动词加ing。
rules: 结构：主语 + be(am/is/are) + 动词-ing
表示说话时正在进行的动作
表示现阶段正在进行但说话时不一定在做的动作
常搭配：now, right now, at the moment, look, listen等
否定：be + not + v-ing；疑问：Be + 主语 + v-ing

examples.en: I am reading a book now.
examples.cn: 我现在正在看书。

examples.en: She is cooking in the kitchen.
examples.cn: 她正在厨房做饭。

examples.en: They are playing football on the playground.
examples.cn: 他们正在操场上踢足球。

examples.en: Look! The bus is coming.
examples.cn: 看！公交车来了。

examples.en: He isn't sleeping right now.
examples.cn: 他现在没有在睡觉。

commonMistakes.wrong: I reading a book now.
commonMistakes.correct: I am reading a book now.
commonMistakes.reason: 现在进行时必须有be动词，不能只有v-ing

commonMistakes.wrong: She is cook in the kitchen.
commonMistakes.correct: She is cooking in the kitchen.
commonMistakes.reason: be动词后要加v-ing形式，不能直接用动词原形

commonMistakes.wrong: He is swiming.
commonMistakes.correct: He is swimming.
commonMistakes.reason: swim是重读闭音节结尾，要双写m再加ing

现在进行时 (Present Continuous).tips: 现在进行时=be+动词ing。Look/Listen是信号词，看到它们就用进行时！

现在进行时 (Present Continuous).name: 现在进行时与一般现在时的区别
现在进行时 (Present Continuous).plainLanguage: 一般现在时说'经常做的事'，现在进行时说'此刻正在做的事'。比如'我每天跑步'是一般现在时（I run every day），'我现在正在跑步'是现在进行时（I am running now）。
rules: 一般现在时：经常性、习惯性的动作，或客观事实
现在进行时：此时此刻正在进行的动作
一般现在时搭配：always, usually, often, every day
现在进行时搭配：now, at the moment, look, listen
某些动词一般不用进行时：know, like, want, believe, understand等状态动词

examples.en: I read books every day. (习惯)
examples.cn: 我每天看书。

examples.en: I am reading a book now. (正在进行)
examples.cn: 我现在正在看书。

examples.en: She usually drinks tea, but today she is drinking coffee.
examples.cn: 她通常喝茶，但今天在喝咖啡。

examples.en: The sun rises in the east. (事实)
examples.cn: 太阳从东方升起。

examples.en: I am understanding you now.
examples.cn: （错误句子，understand不用进行时）

commonMistakes.wrong: I am knowing the answer.
commonMistakes.correct: I know the answer.
commonMistakes.reason: know是状态动词，一般不用进行时

commonMistakes.wrong: She is liking the movie.
commonMistakes.correct: She likes the movie.
commonMistakes.reason: like是状态动词，不用进行时

现在进行时 (Present Continuous).tips: 状态动词（know/like/love/want/need/believe/understand/remember）一般不用进行时！记住：'知道、喜欢、想要'这些不是动作，是状态。

过去进行时 (Past Continuous).name: 过去进行时的基本用法
过去进行时 (Past Continuous).plainLanguage: 过去进行时就是'过去某个时刻正在做的事'。比如'昨天八点我正在吃饭'。结构是was/were + 动词ing。I/he/she/it用was，you/we/they用were。
rules: 结构：主语 + was/were + v-ing
表示过去某时刻正在进行的动作
常搭配：at 8:00 yesterday, at that time, at that moment, when/while
常用于描述过去某个动作发生时的背景
was用于I/he/she/it，were用于you/we/they

examples.en: I was having dinner at 7:00 yesterday.
examples.cn: 昨天七点我正在吃晚饭。

examples.en: She was watching TV when I came in.
examples.cn: 我进来时她正在看电视。

examples.en: They were playing football at that time.
examples.cn: 那时他们正在踢足球。

examples.en: What were you doing at 9:00 last night?
examples.cn: 昨晚九点你在干什么？

examples.en: While he was reading, the phone rang.
examples.cn: 他正在看书时电话响了。

commonMistakes.wrong: I were having dinner at 7:00 yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: I was having dinner at 7:00 yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: I搭配was，不能用were

commonMistakes.wrong: She was watch TV when I came in.
commonMistakes.correct: She was watching TV when I came in.
commonMistakes.reason: 过去进行时结构是was/were + v-ing，不能只用动词原形

commonMistakes.wrong: They was playing football at that time.
commonMistakes.correct: They were playing football at that time.
commonMistakes.reason: they是复数，be动词用were不能用was

过去进行时 (Past Continuous).tips: 过去进行时=was/were+动词ing。I用was，they用were。常和when/while搭配，表示'正做某事时另一件事发生了'。

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).name: 现在完成时的基本用法
现在完成时 (Present Perfect).plainLanguage: 现在完成时就是'已经做了某事，对现在有影响'。比如'我已经吃完了'（现在不饿）。结构是have/has + 动词过去分词。它连接过去和现在——事情是过去做的，但影响延续到现在。
rules: 结构：主语 + have/has + 过去分词
表示过去发生的动作对现在造成的影响
表示过去开始的动作一直持续到现在
常搭配：already, yet, just, ever, never, recently, so far, since, for
否定：haven't/hasn't + 过去分词；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
examples.cn: 我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: She has lived here for ten years.
examples.cn: 她在这里住了十年了。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Japan?
examples.cn: 你去过日本吗？

examples.en: He hasn't come yet.
examples.cn: 他还没来。

examples.en: I have just seen him.
examples.cn: 我刚看到他了。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have finished my homework yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: I finished my homework yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 有明确的过去时间yesterday，要用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时

commonMistakes.wrong: She has lived here since 3 years.
commonMistakes.correct: She has lived here for 3 years.
commonMistakes.reason: for+时间段，since+时间点；3 years是时间段，用for

commonMistakes.wrong: He have gone to the library.
commonMistakes.correct: He has gone to the library.
commonMistakes.reason: he是第三人称单数，用has不能用have

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).tips: 现在完成时=have/has+过去分词。'已经做了'有影响用完成时，有具体过去时间用过去时。since配时间点，for配时间段。

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).name: have been to / have gone to / have been in的区别
现在完成时 (Present Perfect).plainLanguage: have been to = 去过（已回来）；have gone to = 去了（还没回）；have been in = 在某地待了多久。比如'我去过北京'是I have been to Beijing；'他去了北京（还没回）'是He has gone to Beijing。
rules: have/has been to + 地点：曾经去过某地（已回来）
have/has gone to + 地点：去了某地（还没回来）
have/has been in + 地点 + for/since：在某地住了多久
have been to可以搭配次数（twice, three times等）

examples.en: I have been to Shanghai twice.
examples.cn: 我去过上海两次。（已回来）

examples.en: He has gone to the library.
examples.cn: 他去了图书馆。（还没回来）

examples.en: She has been in Beijing for five years.
examples.cn: 她在北京住了五年了。

examples.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?
examples.cn: 你去过长城吗？

examples.en: Where has Tom gone?
examples.cn: 汤姆去哪儿了？

commonMistakes.wrong: He has been to the library. He'll be back soon.
commonMistakes.correct: He has gone to the library. He'll be back soon.
commonMistakes.reason: 他去了还没回来，要用has gone to

commonMistakes.wrong: I have gone to Japan twice.
commonMistakes.correct: I have been to Japan twice.
commonMistakes.reason: 去过已经回来了，要用have been to

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).tips: been to=去过已回；gone to=去了没回；been in=住了多久。看人还在不在就知道用哪个！

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).name: 现在完成时与一般过去时的区别
现在完成时 (Present Perfect).plainLanguage: 一般过去时只管过去，现在完成时连接过去和现在。有具体过去时间（yesterday, last week）用一般过去时；没有具体时间或强调对现在的影响用现在完成时。比如'我昨天丢了钥匙'用过去时；'我把钥匙丢了（现在找不到）'用完成时。
rules: 一般过去时：有明确的过去时间状语
现在完成时：没有明确过去时间，或强调对现在的影响
有yesterday/last week/... ago/in 2010等，用一般过去时
有already/yet/just/ever/never/recently/so far等，用现在完成时
现在完成时不能和具体的过去时间连用

examples.en: I lost my keys yesterday. (一般过去时)
examples.cn: 我昨天丢了钥匙。

examples.en: I have lost my keys. I can't open the door now. (现在完成时)
examples.cn: 我把钥匙丢了，现在打不开门。

examples.en: Did you see him yesterday? - Yes, I did.
examples.cn: 你昨天看到他了吗？——是的。

examples.en: Have you seen him recently? - No, I haven't.
examples.cn: 你最近看到他了吗？——没有。

examples.en: She has written three books so far.
examples.cn: 到目前为止她已经写了三本书。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have seen him yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: I saw him yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 有明确的过去时间yesterday，必须用一般过去时saw

commonMistakes.wrong: Did you ever been to Paris?
commonMistakes.correct: Have you ever been to Paris?
commonMistakes.reason: ever用于现在完成时，不能用一般过去时的Did提问

现在完成时 (Present Perfect).tips: 有具体过去时间→一般过去时；没有具体时间/强调影响→现在完成时。看到already/yet/just/ever/never/so far就用现在完成时！

过去完成时 (Past Perfect).name: 过去完成时的基本用法
过去完成时 (Past Perfect).plainLanguage: 过去完成时就是'过去的过去'。当你讲一个过去的事，想说明在这之前还发生了另一件事，那个更早的事就用过去完成时。比如'我到火车站时火车已经走了'——火车走在我到达之前，所以'走了'用过去完成时。
rules: 结构：had + 过去分词
表示在过去某个时间或动作之前已经完成的动作（过去的过去）
常搭配：by the time, before, after, when, by the end of等
否定：had not (hadn't) + 过去分词
必须有另一个过去的时间作参照

examples.en: The train had left when I arrived at the station.
examples.cn: 我到火车站时火车已经走了。

examples.en: She had finished her work before 6 o'clock.
examples.cn: 她在六点前就完成了工作。

examples.en: By the time we got there, the meeting had ended.
examples.cn: 我们到那儿时，会议已经结束了。

examples.en: He told me that he had seen the movie before.
examples.cn: 他告诉我他以前看过那部电影。

examples.en: I had never seen snow before I came to Harbin.
examples.cn: 来哈尔滨之前我从没见过雪。

commonMistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the train left already.
commonMistakes.correct: When I arrived, the train had left.
commonMistakes.reason: 火车走在我到达之前，是'过去的过去'，要用过去完成时had left

commonMistakes.wrong: He had finished his homework yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: He finished his homework yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 有明确的过去时间yesterday且没有参照另一过去动作，用一般过去时即可

commonMistakes.wrong: She has left when I arrived.
commonMistakes.correct: She had left when I arrived.
commonMistakes.reason: 参照的arrived是过去时，leave在它之前，要用过去完成时had left而不是现在完成时has left

过去完成时 (Past Perfect).tips: 过去完成时='过去的过去'。必须有两个过去动作，先发生的用had+过去分词，后发生的用一般过去时。

现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous).name: 现在完成进行时的用法
现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous).plainLanguage: 现在完成进行时就是'从过去开始一直做到现在，还在做'。比如'我等了一个小时了（还在等）'。结构是have/has been + 动词ing。强调动作的持续性和还在进行。
rules: 结构：have/has + been + v-ing
表示从过去某时开始一直持续到现在的动作（可能还在继续）
强调动作的持续性和过程
常搭配：for + 时间段, since + 时间点, all morning, all day等
不用进行时的状态动词用现在完成时替代

examples.en: I have been waiting for you for an hour.
examples.cn: 我等了你一个小时了。

examples.en: She has been learning English since she was ten.
examples.cn: 她从十岁起就一直在学英语。

examples.en: They have been working all morning.
examples.cn: 他们一上午都在工作。

examples.en: It has been raining for three days.
examples.cn: 雨已经下了三天了。

examples.en: How long have you been studying here?
examples.cn: 你在这里学习多久了？

commonMistakes.wrong: I have waited for you for an hour.
commonMistakes.correct: I have been waiting for you for an hour.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调一直在等（可能还在等），用现在完成进行时更合适。现在完成时强调结果，完成进行时强调过程

commonMistakes.wrong: She has been knowing him for years.
commonMistakes.correct: She has known him for years.
commonMistakes.reason: know是状态动词，不用进行时，包括完成进行时也不行

现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous).tips: 强调'一直在做还在做'用完成进行时（have been doing）。状态动词（know/like/love等）用完成时。

过去将来时 (Past Future).name: 过去将来时的基本用法
过去将来时 (Past Future).plainLanguage: 过去将来时就是'从过去某个时间点看，将要发生的事'。常出现在宾语从句里，比如'他说他第二天要来'——他说话时是过去，来的动作还没发生，所以用过去将来时。
rules: 结构：would + 动词原形
表示从过去某时间点看将要发生的动作
常用于宾语从句中，主句是过去时，从句表示将来的事
was/were going to + 动词原形也可表示过去将来
was/were about to + 动词原形：当时马上要发生的事

examples.en: He said he would come the next day.
examples.cn: 他说他第二天会来。

examples.en: I thought she would pass the exam.
examples.cn: 我以为她会通过考试。

examples.en: She was going to leave when the phone rang.
examples.cn: 她正要离开时电话响了。

examples.en: They told us they would arrive at 5 p.m.
examples.cn: 他们告诉我们他们下午五点到。

examples.en: He said he was going to buy a new car.
examples.cn: 他说他打算买辆新车。

commonMistakes.wrong: He said he will come the next day.
commonMistakes.correct: He said he would come the next day.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句said是过去时，从句要用过去将来时would，不能直接用will（时态要呼应）

commonMistakes.wrong: I thought she will pass the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: I thought she would pass the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: thought是过去时，后面从句的将来时要降级为过去将来时would

过去将来时 (Past Future).tips: 过去将来时=would+原形。看到'said/thought/told'+将来的事，把will变成would！

过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous).name: 过去完成进行时
过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous).plainLanguage: 过去完成进行时就是'在过去某个时间点之前，一直在做某事，而且还在做'。结构是had been + 动词ing。比如'我到的时候他已经等了两个小时了（还在等）'。它强调一个动作从过去某时开始一直持续到另一个过去时间。
rules: 结构：had been + v-ing
表示从过去某时开始一直持续到另一个过去时间点的动作（强调持续性）
常搭配：for + 时间段, since + 时间点
与过去完成时的区别：过去完成时强调完成，过去完成进行时强调一直在做
状态动词（know/love等）不用进行时，改用过去完成时

examples.en: He had been waiting for two hours when I arrived.
examples.cn: 我到的时候他已经等了两个小时了。

examples.en: She had been studying English for five years before she went abroad.
examples.cn: 出国前她已经学了五年英语了。

examples.en: They had been talking for an hour before the teacher came in.
examples.cn: 老师进来前他们已经聊了一个小时了。

examples.en: It had been raining for a week when the sun finally came out.
examples.cn: 太阳终于出来前已经下了一个星期的雨了。

examples.en: How long had you been living there before you moved?
examples.cn: 搬走前你在那里住了多久？

commonMistakes.wrong: He had waited for two hours when I arrived.
commonMistakes.correct: He had been waiting for two hours when I arrived.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调一直在等（可能还在等），用过去完成进行时had been waiting更合适

commonMistakes.wrong: He had been knowing her for years.
commonMistakes.correct: He had known her for years.
commonMistakes.reason: know是状态动词，不用进行时，用过去完成时had known

过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous).tips: 过去完成进行时=had been doing，强调'过去某时之前一直在做'。和过去完成时的区别：完成时看结果，完成进行时看过程。

将来进行时 (Future Continuous).name: 将来进行时
将来进行时 (Future Continuous).plainLanguage: 将来进行时就是'将来某个时间点正在做的事'。结构是will be + 动词ing。比如'明天这个时候我正在考试'。它强调将来某时正在进行的动作，比will do更具体、更生动。
rules: 结构：will be + v-ing
表示将来某个具体时间点正在进行的动作
强调动作的过程，画面感更强
也可以表示按计划即将发生的事（比will do更委婉自然）
常搭配：this time tomorrow, at 8 o'clock tomorrow, at that time等将来时间点

examples.en: This time tomorrow, I will be taking the exam.
examples.cn: 明天这个时候我正在考试。

examples.en: At 8 o'clock, she will be having dinner.
examples.cn: 八点钟她会在吃晚饭。

examples.en: Don't call me at 10. I'll be having a meeting.
examples.cn: 十点别给我打电话，我会在开会。

examples.en: We will be flying to Paris next week.
examples.cn: 下周我们将飞往巴黎。（按计划）

examples.en: I will be waiting for you at the gate.
examples.cn: 我会在门口等你。

commonMistakes.wrong: This time tomorrow, I will take the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: This time tomorrow, I will be taking the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调明天这个时候'正在'考试，用将来进行时will be taking

commonMistakes.wrong: At 8 o'clock, she will have dinner.
commonMistakes.correct: At 8 o'clock, she will be having dinner.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调八点那个时间点'正在'吃晚饭，用将来进行时更准确

将来进行时 (Future Continuous).tips: 将来进行时=will be doing，表示'将来某时正在做'。看到this time tomorrow/at 8 o'clock tomorrow，用将来进行时！

将来完成时 (Future Perfect).name: 将来完成时
将来完成时 (Future Perfect).plainLanguage: 将来完成时就是'到将来某个时间为止已经做完的事'。结构是will have + 过去分词。比如'到明年年底我就毕业了'。它强调在将来某个截止时间之前已经完成的动作。
rules: 结构：will have + 过去分词
表示在将来某个时间之前已经完成的动作
常搭配：by + 将来时间，by the end of, by then, before等
强调在截止时间点之前已经完成
否定：will not (won't) have + 过去分词

examples.en: By the end of this year, I will have graduated.
examples.cn: 到今年年底我就毕业了。

examples.en: She will have finished the report by 5 p.m.
examples.cn: 她将在下午五点前完成报告。

examples.en: By the time you arrive, we will have eaten dinner.
examples.cn: 等你到的时候，我们已经吃完晚饭了。

examples.en: They will have built the bridge by next month.
examples.cn: 他们下个月前就会建好这座桥。

examples.en: I will have lived here for ten years by 2026.
examples.cn: 到2026年我在这里就住了十年了。

commonMistakes.wrong: By the end of this year, I will graduate.
commonMistakes.correct: By the end of this year, I will have graduated.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调到年底'已经'毕业，用将来完成时will have graduated

commonMistakes.wrong: By the time you arrive, we will eat dinner.
commonMistakes.correct: By the time you arrive, we will have eaten dinner.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调等你到的时候'已经'吃完，用将来完成时will have eaten

将来完成时 (Future Perfect).tips: 将来完成时=will have done，表示'到将来某时已完成'。看到by + 将来时间，就用将来完成时！

主动语态 (Active Voice).name: 主动语态的使用场景
主动语态 (Active Voice).plainLanguage: 主动语态就是'谁做了什么'，主语是动作的执行者。比如'我打破了杯子'——我是执行打破动作的人。日常说话大多用主动语态，更直接更自然。
rules: 结构：主语（动作执行者）+ 谓语动词 + 宾语（动作承受者）
主语是动作的发出者
更直接、更有力，日常交流首选
当不知道/不需要说出动作执行者时，换用被动语态

examples.en: I broke the window.
examples.cn: 我打破了窗户。

examples.en: Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.
examples.cn: 莎士比亚写了《哈姆雷特》。

examples.en: The teacher praised the student.
examples.cn: 老师表扬了那个学生。

examples.en: We will build a new bridge.
examples.cn: 我们将建一座新桥。

examples.en: People speak English all over the world.
examples.cn: 全世界的人都说英语。

commonMistakes.wrong: The window broke by me.
commonMistakes.correct: I broke the window.
commonMistakes.reason: 主动语态中主语是动作执行者，应说I broke the window；如要用被动应说The window was broken by me.

commonMistakes.wrong: Hamlet was wrote by Shakespeare.
commonMistakes.correct: Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.
commonMistakes.reason: 主动语态动词不用过去分词，直接用过去式wrote

主动语态 (Active Voice).tips: 主动语态=主语做动作。强调'谁做的'用主动，强调'被怎么样了'用被动。

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 被动语态的基本构成
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 被动语态就是'什么被怎么了'，主语是动作的承受者。比如'杯子被打破了'——杯子是被打破的对象。结构是be + 过去分词。不知道谁做的、或者不想说谁做的，就用被动。
rules: 结构：主语 + be + 过去分词（+ by + 动作执行者）
be动词的时态随句意变化：is/am/are, was/were, will be, have/has been等
by短语可选，用于指出动作执行者
不知道执行者或执行者不重要时用被动语态
及物动词才有被动语态

examples.en: The window was broken by Tom.
examples.cn: 窗户被汤姆打破了。

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.cn: 很多国家说英语。

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.cn: 这座桥建于1990年。

examples.en: The letter was sent yesterday.
examples.cn: 信昨天被寄出了。

examples.en: This problem will be solved soon.
examples.cn: 这个问题很快就会被解决。

commonMistakes.wrong: The window was break by Tom.
commonMistakes.correct: The window was broken by Tom.
commonMistakes.reason: 被动语态用be + 过去分词，break的过去分词是broken

commonMistakes.wrong: English is spoke in many countries.
commonMistakes.correct: English is spoken in many countries.
commonMistakes.reason: speak的过去分词是spoken，不是spoke

commonMistakes.wrong: The bridge built in 1990.
commonMistakes.correct: The bridge was built in 1990.
commonMistakes.reason: 被动语态必须有be动词was/were，不能只有过去分词

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 被动=be+过去分词。be看时态，分词不能忘。by谁做的可以省略。

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 各时态的被动语态
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 被动语态的be动词要跟着时态变。一般现在时用is/am/are+done，一般过去时用was/were+done，一般将来时用will be+done，现在完成时用have/has been+done。记住'be变时态，分词不变'。
rules: 一般现在时：is/am/are + done
一般过去时：was/were + done
一般将来时：will be + done
现在进行时：is/am/are being + done
现在完成时：have/has been + done
过去完成时：had been + done

examples.en: The room is cleaned every day.
examples.cn: 房间每天被打扫。（一般现在时被动）

examples.en: The car was repaired yesterday.
examples.cn: 车昨天被修了。（一般过去时被动）

examples.en: A new school will be built next year.
examples.cn: 明年将建一所新学校。（一般将来时被动）

examples.en: The house is being painted now.
examples.cn: 房子正在被粉刷。（现在进行时被动）

examples.en: The work has been finished.
examples.cn: 工作已经完成了。（现在完成时被动）

commonMistakes.wrong: The room is clean every day.
commonMistakes.correct: The room is cleaned every day.
commonMistakes.reason: 被动语态要用过去分词cleaned，clean是原形不是分词

commonMistakes.wrong: The house is painting now.
commonMistakes.correct: The house is being painted now.
commonMistakes.reason: 房子被粉刷，要用被动进行时is being painted

commonMistakes.wrong: The work has finished.
commonMistakes.correct: The work has been finished.
commonMistakes.reason: 工作是被完成的，要用被动语态has been finished

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 被动=be（随时态变）+ 过去分词（不变）。进行时多加being，完成时多加been。

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 带情态动词的被动语态
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 情态动词后面加被动很简单：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。比如'必须完成'是must be done，'可以做'是can be done。记住情态动词后面永远接动词原形，被动语态的原形就是be。
rules: 结构：情态动词（can/must/should/may等）+ be + 过去分词
情态动词后be动词用原形
否定：情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词
疑问：情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词

examples.en: The work must be done today.
examples.cn: 这项工作必须今天完成。

examples.en: This problem can be solved easily.
examples.cn: 这个问题可以轻松解决。

examples.en: The rules should be followed by everyone.
examples.cn: 这些规则应该被所有人遵守。

examples.en: This book can't be taken out of the library.
examples.cn: 这本书不能带出图书馆。

examples.en: Must the report be handed in today?
examples.cn: 报告必须今天交吗？

commonMistakes.wrong: The work must done today.
commonMistakes.correct: The work must be done today.
commonMistakes.reason: 情态动词被动需要must + be + done，不能省略be动词

commonMistakes.wrong: This problem can be solve easily.
commonMistakes.correct: This problem can be solved easily.
commonMistakes.reason: 被动语态要用过去分词solved，不是动词原形solve

commonMistakes.wrong: The book mustn't taken out.
commonMistakes.correct: The book mustn't be taken out.
commonMistakes.reason: 情态动词否定被动也要有be动词

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 情态动词被动=情态动词+be+过去分词。be永远用原形，因为它跟在情态动词后面。

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 双宾语和复合宾语的被动语态
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 有些动词给两个宾语（给人+给物），变被动时可以选人当主语或选物当主语。选物当主语时，人前面要加to或for。比如'She gave me a book'变被动可以是'A book was given to me'。
rules: 双宾语动词（give/show/send/bring等）：间接宾语（人）提前直接做主语
直接宾语（物）提前做主语时，间接宾语前要加to（give类）或for（buy/cook类）
复合宾语（宾+宾补）变被动：原宾语做主语，宾补留原位
make/see/hear/let等使役动词变被动时，原省略的to要补回（如make sb do → sb be made to do）

examples.en: I was given a book. / A book was given to me.
examples.cn: 有人给了我一本书。

examples.en: She was bought a dress. / A dress was bought for her.
examples.cn: 有人给她买了条裙子。

examples.en: He was made to work overtime.
examples.cn: 他被要求加班。（主动语态是make him work overtime）

examples.en: The boy was seen to enter the building.
examples.cn: 有人看到男孩进入了大楼。

examples.en: We were called good students by the teacher.
examples.cn: 老师叫我们好学生。

commonMistakes.wrong: A book was given me.
commonMistakes.correct: A book was given to me.
commonMistakes.reason: 直接宾语提前做主语时，间接宾语前要加to

commonMistakes.wrong: He was made work overtime.
commonMistakes.correct: He was made to work overtime.
commonMistakes.reason: make sb do变被动后要补回省略的to，变成be made to do

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 双宾语被动：人提前不用to，物提前人前面要加to/for。使役动词被动要补to！

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 被动语态的特殊用法（It is said that等）
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 有些被动结构已经成为固定句式，比如'据说'是It is said that，'据报道'是It is reported that。这些句子的it是形式主语，真正主语是that后面的内容。还有一种简化说法：sb is said to do（据说某人做某事）。
rules: It is said that... = 据说...
It is reported that... = 据报道...
It is believed that... = 人们认为...
It is well known that... = 众所周知...
It is expected that... = 预计...
简化形式：sb/sth is said/reported to do/to have done

examples.en: It is said that he is a billionaire.
examples.cn: 据说他是亿万富翁。

examples.en: It is reported that the earthquake caused 100 deaths.
examples.cn: 据报道地震造成100人死亡。

examples.en: It is believed that exercise is good for health.
examples.cn: 人们认为运动对健康有益。

examples.en: He is said to have written ten books.
examples.cn: 据说他已经写了十本书。（have written表示已完成）

examples.en: It is expected that the price will go up.
examples.cn: 预计价格会上涨。

commonMistakes.wrong: It is said he is a billionaire.
commonMistakes.correct: It is said that he is a billionaire.
commonMistakes.reason: It is said that结构中that一般不省略（正式语体中）

commonMistakes.wrong: He is said to write ten books.
commonMistakes.correct: He is said to have written ten books.
commonMistakes.reason: 写书发生在is said之前（已完成），要用to have written

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 记住几个常用被动句式：It is said that=据说，It is reported that=据报道，It is believed that=人们认为。简化版：sb is said to do（同时/将来）/to have done（已完成）。

被动语态 (Passive Voice).name: 不能用被动语态的动词
被动语态 (Passive Voice).plainLanguage: 不是所有动词都能变被动！表示'拥有'的have、'适合'的fit、'像'的resemble这些表示状态的及物动词，没有被动形式。'这双鞋适合你'只能说The shoes fit you，不能说You are fitted by the shoes。不及物动词（happen/arrive）本身没有宾语，更不可能有被动。
rules: 状态及物动词无被动：have(有), fit, suit, lack, resemble(像), cost(花费), weigh, measure, hold(容纳)
不及物动词无被动：happen, occur, arrive, appear, exist, belong to
某些固定搭配无被动：take place(发生), break out(爆发), belong to(属于)
表示相互关系的动词用主动表被动：meet(见面), shake hands(握手)
某些动词的特定含义不用被动：sell well(畅销), read(读起来), wash easily(好洗)

examples.en: He has a new car.（不能说A new car is had by him.）
examples.cn: 他有一辆新车。

examples.en: The shoes fit me perfectly.（不能说I am fitted by the shoes.）
examples.cn: 这双鞋很适合我。

examples.en: She resembles her mother.（不能说Her mother is resembled by her.）
examples.cn: 她长得像她妈妈。

examples.en: The accident happened yesterday.（不能说The accident was happened yesterday.）
examples.cn: 事故发生在昨天。

examples.en: This book sells well.（主动表被动，畅销）
examples.cn: 这本书很畅销。

commonMistakes.wrong: A new car is had by him.
commonMistakes.correct: He has a new car.
commonMistakes.reason: have表示'拥有'是状态动词，不能变被动语态

commonMistakes.wrong: The accident was happened yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: The accident happened yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: happen是不及物动词，不能用被动语态

commonMistakes.wrong: I am fitted by the shoes.
commonMistakes.correct: The shoes fit me.
commonMistakes.reason: fit表示'适合'是状态动词，不能变被动

被动语态 (Passive Voice).tips: 记住不能变被动的动词：have/fit/suit/lack/resemble/cost/weigh（状态），happen/occur/arrive/belong to（不及物）。'物+sell/read/wash+well/ easily'用主动表被动。

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 关系代词that/which/who的用法
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: 定语从句就是'用一个小句子来修饰一个名词'。比如'穿红衣服的女孩'在英语里就是'the girl who is wearing red'。who修饰人，which修饰物，that既可修饰人也可修饰物。它们在从句中作主语或宾语。
rules: who：修饰人，在从句中作主语或宾语（作宾语可省略）
whom：修饰人，在从句中作宾语（口语中可省略或用who代替）
which：修饰物，在从句中作主语或宾语
that：修饰人或物，在从句中作主语或宾语
作宾语时关系代词可以省略

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
examples.cn: 住在隔壁的那个男人是医生。

examples.en: The book which/that is on the table is mine.
examples.cn: 桌上那本书是我的。

examples.en: I know the girl (who/that) you met yesterday.
examples.cn: 我认识你昨天遇到的那个女孩。（作宾语可省略）

examples.en: This is the movie that/which everyone is talking about.
examples.cn: 这就是大家都在讨论的那部电影。

examples.en: The teacher who teaches us English is from America.
examples.cn: 教我们英语的那位老师来自美国。

commonMistakes.wrong: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.correct: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.reason: 修饰人用who，不能用which

commonMistakes.wrong: The man who he lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.correct: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
commonMistakes.reason: 关系代词who在从句中作主语，后面不能再加he

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: who管人，which管物，that都能管。作宾语可以省。从句中不要重复主语/宾语！
relatedCategories: 限制性与非限制性定语从句

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 介词+关系代词
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: 有时候关系代词前面可以加介词，比如'the room in which I live'（我住的房间）。人用whom，物用which。注意：加了介词后不能用that！口语中也可以把介词放到句末，用that/who/which或省略。
rules: 介词 + whom（修饰人）
介词 + which（修饰物）
介词+关系代词时不能用that
介词可移至从句末尾，此时关系代词可用that/who/which或省略
固定搭配中的介词不能提前（如look at, take care of中的介词不能移到which前面）

examples.en: The room in which I live is very small.
examples.cn: 我住的房间很小。

examples.en: The person to whom I spoke is our principal.
examples.cn: 和我说话的那个人是我们的校长。

examples.en: This is the book about which we were talking.
examples.cn: 这就是我们在讨论的那本书。

examples.en: The room (that) I live in is very small.
examples.cn: 我住的房间很小。（介词后移，可省略关系代词）

examples.en: He is the man from whom I learned a lot.
examples.cn: 他就是那个让我学到很多的人。

commonMistakes.wrong: The room in that I live is very small.
commonMistakes.correct: The room in which I live is very small.
commonMistakes.reason: 介词后面不能用that，只能用which（物）或whom（人）

commonMistakes.wrong: The person to who I spoke is our principal.
commonMistakes.correct: The person to whom I spoke is our principal.
commonMistakes.reason: 介词后修饰人用whom，不能用who

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: 介词+which管物，介词+whom管人，千万别用that！固定搭配的介词不能提前。
relatedCategories: 限制性与非限制性定语从句

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 关系副词when/where/why
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: when修饰时间（什么时候），where修饰地点（什么地方），why修饰原因（为什么）。它们等于'介词+which'：when=at/on/in which，where=in/at which，why=for which。
rules: when：修饰表示时间的先行词，在从句中作时间状语（= 介词+which）
where：修饰表示地点的先行词，在从句中作地点状语（= 介词+which）
why：修饰表示原因的先行词（如reason），在从句中作原因状语（= for which）
关系副词不能作主语或宾语
关系副词=介词+which，可互换使用

examples.en: I still remember the day when I first met her.
examples.cn: 我还记得第一次见到她的那天。

examples.en: This is the city where I was born.
examples.cn: 这就是我出生的城市。

examples.en: That is the reason why he was late.
examples.cn: 那就是他迟到的原因。

examples.en: I'll never forget the day on which I graduated.
examples.cn: 我永远不会忘记毕业那天。

examples.en: This is the house where/in which Lu Xun once lived.
examples.cn: 这就是鲁迅曾经住过的房子。

commonMistakes.wrong: I still remember the day when I first met her there.
commonMistakes.correct: I still remember the day when I first met her.
commonMistakes.reason: when已经在从句中充当了时间状语，后面不能再用there等地点副词

commonMistakes.wrong: This is the city where I was born in.
commonMistakes.correct: This is the city where I was born.
commonMistakes.reason: where已经包含了in的含义，不能再加介词in

commonMistakes.wrong: This is the city which I was born.
commonMistakes.correct: This is the city where I was born.
commonMistakes.reason: 从句I was born缺少地点状语，应该用where而不是which（which只作主语/宾语）

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: when管时间，where管地点，why管原因。它们都等于'介词+which'。从句里不能再重复介词！

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 限制性与非限制性定语从句
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: 限制性定语从句是'不可缺少的'——去掉后句子意思不明确，不用逗号隔开。非限制性是'补充说明的'——去掉也不影响主句意思，用逗号隔开，且不能用that。
rules: 限制性定语从句：不用逗号隔开，关系代词可用that，作宾语可省略
非限制性定语从句：用逗号隔开，不能用that，关系代词不可省略
非限制性定语从句只是对先行词补充说明，去掉不影响主句意思
修饰专有名词时通常用非限制性定语从句
非限制性定语从句的which可指代整个主句

examples.en: Students who work hard will pass the exam.
examples.cn: 努力学习的学生会通过考试。（限制性——指特定学生）

examples.en: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a teacher.
examples.cn: 我哥哥，住在北京，是个老师。（非限制性——只有一个哥哥）

examples.en: He passed the exam, which made his parents happy.
examples.cn: 他通过了考试，这让他父母很高兴。（which指代整个主句）

examples.en: I love the book that you gave me.
examples.cn: 我喜欢你给我的那本书。（限制性）

examples.en: Paris, which is the capital of France, is a beautiful city.
examples.cn: 巴黎是法国的首都，是一座美丽的城市。（非限制性）

commonMistakes.wrong: My brother, that lives in Beijing, is a teacher.
commonMistakes.correct: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a teacher.
commonMistakes.reason: 非限制性定语从句不能用that，只能用who/which

commonMistakes.wrong: Students, who work hard, will pass the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: Students who work hard will pass the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: 这里需要限制性定语从句（不是所有学生都通过，只有努力的），不该用逗号隔开

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: 有逗号=非限制=不用that；没逗号=限制性=可以用that。专有名词通常配非限制性。

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: as引导的定语从句
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: as也可以引导定语从句，意思是'正如...一样'。它常用于固定搭配如as we know（正如我们所知）、as is known to all（众所周知）。as引导的非限制性定语从句可放在句首、句中或句末。
rules: as引导非限制性定语从句，意为'正如...'
as可放在句首、句中或句末（比which灵活）
常见搭配：as we know, as is known to all, as has been mentioned等
as在从句中一般作主语或宾语
as与which引导非限制性从句的区别：as有'正如'的意思，which没有

examples.en: As we all know, the earth is round.
examples.cn: 众所周知，地球是圆的。

examples.en: He is from Australia, as is evident from his accent.
examples.cn: 他是澳大利亚人，这从他的口音很明显。

examples.en: As has been mentioned above, water is important.
examples.cn: 如上所述，水很重要。

examples.en: Taiwan is an inseparable part of China, as is known to all.
examples.cn: 众所周知，台湾是中国不可分割的一部分。

examples.en: She is very careful, as her work shows.
examples.cn: 她很细心，正如她的工作所显示的那样。

commonMistakes.wrong: Which we all know, the earth is round.
commonMistakes.correct: As we all know, the earth is round.
commonMistakes.reason: 在句首引导非限制性定语从句时，只能用as，不能用which

commonMistakes.wrong: As is known to all that the earth is round.
commonMistakes.correct: As is known to all, the earth is round.
commonMistakes.reason: as引导的是定语从句，后面跟逗号；如果用that则是主语从句，结构不同

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: 句首用as不用which（正如...）。固定搭配要背：as we know/as is known to all/as has been said。
relatedCategories: 限制性与非限制性定语从句

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 定语从句中that与which的区别
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: that和which都能修饰物，但在某些情况下只能选一个。口诀：限制性可用that或which，非限制性只能用which；介词后面只能用which；先行词是不不定代词、被最高级或序数词修饰时只能用that。
rules: 只能用that的情况：①先行词是不定代词（all/everything/nothing/anything等）②先行词被最高级修饰③先行词被序数词修饰④先行词既有人又有物⑤在疑问词which/who之后避免重复
只能用which的情况：①非限制性定语从句（有逗号）②介词后面（in which, of which）
限制性定语从句中修饰物时，that和which一般可互换
that不能引导非限制性定语从句
which不能紧跟在介词后换成that（介词后只能用which）

examples.en: This is the best movie that I have ever seen.
examples.cn: 这是我看过最好的电影。（最高级best修饰，只能用that）

examples.en: All that glitters is not gold.
examples.cn: 闪光的未必都是金子。（不定代词all，只能用that）

examples.en: He bought a new car, which cost a lot of money.
examples.cn: 他买了辆新车，花了很多钱。（非限制性，只能用which）

examples.en: This is the house in which Lu Xun once lived.
examples.cn: 这是鲁迅曾经住过的房子。（介词in后只能用which）

examples.en: The train and the passengers that were delayed have arrived.
examples.cn: 被延误的火车和乘客已经到了。（人和物，只能用that）

commonMistakes.wrong: This is the best movie which I have ever seen.
commonMistakes.correct: This is the best movie that I have ever seen.
commonMistakes.reason: 先行词movie被最高级best修饰，只能用that

commonMistakes.wrong: He bought a new car, that cost a lot of money.
commonMistakes.correct: He bought a new car, which cost a lot of money.
commonMistakes.reason: 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）不能用that，只能用which

commonMistakes.wrong: This is the house in that Lu Xun once lived.
commonMistakes.correct: This is the house in which Lu Xun once lived.
commonMistakes.reason: 介词in后面只能用which，不能用that

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: 只用that五情况：不定代词、最高级、序数词、人加物、疑问词后。只用which两情况：有逗号（非限制）、介词后。
relatedCategories: 限制性与非限制性定语从句

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).name: 关系代词as与which引导非限制性定语从句的区别
定语从句 (Attributive Clause).plainLanguage: as和which都能引导非限制性定语从句指代整个主句，但有区别：as有'正如'的意思，可以放在句首、句中或句末；which没有'正如'的意思，只能放在句中或句末，不能放句首。'众所周知'只能用As is known to all，不能用Which is known to all。
rules: as引导非限制性定语从句：意为'正如...'，可放句首、句中、句末
which引导非限制性定语从句：意为'这一点'，只能放句中或句末，不能放句首
as常用于固定搭配：as we know, as is known to all, as has been mentioned, as is expected
as多表示主句内容的'顺承'关系（与预期一致）
which可表示对主句内容的补充、评价或转折

examples.en: As we all know, the earth is round.
examples.cn: 众所周知，地球是圆的。（as在句首=正如）

examples.en: He is from Australia, as is evident from his accent.
examples.cn: 他是澳大利亚人，这从他的口音很明显。（as=正如）

examples.en: He failed the exam, which surprised everyone.
examples.cn: 他考试不及格，这让所有人吃惊。（which不能换成as，因为是意外转折）

examples.en: She married him, which was unexpected.
examples.cn: 她嫁给了他，这出乎意料。（which表转折，不用as）

examples.en: As has been mentioned above, practice makes perfect.
examples.cn: 如上所述，熟能生巧。

commonMistakes.wrong: Which we all know, the earth is round.
commonMistakes.correct: As we all know, the earth is round.
commonMistakes.reason: 非限制性定语从句在句首时只能用as，不能用which

commonMistakes.wrong: He failed the exam, as surprised everyone.
commonMistakes.correct: He failed the exam, which surprised everyone.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句内容是'让人吃惊'的意外结果，不是'正如'的顺承关系，用which不用as

定语从句 (Attributive Clause).tips: 句首只能用as（正如）。表'正如/符合预期'用as，表'意外/转折'用which。背固定搭配：as we know/as is known to all/as has been said。
relatedCategories: 限制性与非限制性定语从句

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: that引导的名词性从句
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: that引导名词性从句时，that只起连接作用，不充当句子成分，也没有实际意思。可以当主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句、同位语从句。注意：that在宾语从句中可省略，但在主语从句、表语从句、同位语从句中一般不省。
rules: that在名词性从句中只起连接作用，不作成分，无实义
主语从句：That + 从句 + 谓语（that不可省）
宾语从句：动词 + that + 从句（口语中that可省）
表语从句：be + that + 从句（that不可省）
同位语从句：名词 + that + 从句（that不可省）

examples.en: That she survived the earthquake is a miracle.
examples.cn: 她在地震中幸存下来是个奇迹。（主语从句）

examples.en: I believe (that) you can do it.
examples.cn: 我相信你能做到。（宾语从句，that可省）

examples.en: The truth is that he lied to us.
examples.cn: 事实是他对我们撒了谎。（表语从句）

examples.en: The news that he won the prize excited everyone.
examples.cn: 他获奖的消息让所有人兴奋。（同位语从句）

examples.en: It is clear that he is innocent.
examples.cn: 很明显他是无辜的。（it作形式主语，that从句是真正主语）

commonMistakes.wrong: That he is a good student is well known.
commonMistakes.correct: That he is a good student is well known. / It is well known that he is a good student.
commonMistakes.reason: 原句语法正确，但更常用it作形式主语的结构：It is well known that...

commonMistakes.wrong: I believe that you are right and you will win.
commonMistakes.correct: I believe that you are right and that you will win.
commonMistakes.reason: 第二个宾语从句前也应有that（引导两个并列宾语从句时，第二个that不能省略）

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: that只连接不作成分，宾语从句可省略，主语从句用it开头更地道。两个并列宾语从句，第二个that别忘加。

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: whether与if的用法区别
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: whether和if都可以表示'是否'，但whether更全能——它可以用在所有名词性从句中，而if只能用在宾语从句中。记住'if不能放在句首'，所以主语从句、表语从句、同位语从句只能用whether。
rules: whether可用于所有名词性从句（主语/宾语/表语/同位语）
if只能引导宾语从句，不能用于主语从句、表语从句、同位语从句
句首的宾语从句也只能用whether（不能用if）
whether后可加or not，if后一般不加or not（except 'whether or not'结构）
whether可接不定式（whether to do），if不能

examples.en: Whether he will come is still unknown.
examples.cn: 他是否会来还不知道。（主语从句，只能用whether）

examples.en: I don't know whether/if he will come.
examples.cn: 我不知道他会不会来。（宾语从句，两者都可）

examples.en: The question is whether we should go.
examples.cn: 问题是我们是否应该去。（表语从句，只能用whether）

examples.en: I wonder whether to go or to stay.
examples.cn: 我在想是去还是留。（whether + to do）

examples.en: The question whether he is guilty remains.
examples.cn: 他是否有罪这个问题仍未解决。（同位语从句，只能用whether）

commonMistakes.wrong: If he will come is still unknown.
commonMistakes.correct: Whether he will come is still unknown.
commonMistakes.reason: 主语从句不能用if，只能用whether

commonMistakes.wrong: The question is if we should go.
commonMistakes.correct: The question is whether we should go.
commonMistakes.reason: 表语从句不能用if，只能用whether

commonMistakes.wrong: I don't know if to go or not.
commonMistakes.correct: I don't know whether to go or not.
commonMistakes.reason: whether后面可以接不定式，if不能

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: whether全场景通用，if只能做宾语从句。句首用whether，后面跟to do用whether，后面跟or not用whether。
relatedCategories: 疑问词引导的名词性从句

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: 疑问词引导的名词性从句
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: who/what/when/where/why/how等疑问词都可以引导名词性从句。注意：在从句中要用陈述语序（主语+谓语），不能用疑问语序（谓语+主语）。比如'我不知道他是谁'是I don't know who he is，不是who is he。
rules: 疑问词（who/what/when/where/why/how等）引导名词性从句
从句必须用陈述语序：主语 + 谓语
疑问词在从句中充当成分（主语/宾语/表语/状语）
从句的时态要与主句呼应
疑问词的意思在从句中保留

examples.en: I don't know where he lives.
examples.cn: 我不知道他住哪里。（不是where does he live）

examples.en: What she said is true.
examples.cn: 她说的是真的。（主语从句）

examples.en: The question is how we can solve this problem.
examples.cn: 问题是我们如何解决这个问题。（表语从句）

examples.en: Can you tell me when the train arrives?
examples.cn: 你能告诉我火车什么时候到吗？（宾语从句，陈述语序）

examples.en: I wonder why he was late.
examples.cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。

commonMistakes.wrong: I don't know where does he live.
commonMistakes.correct: I don't know where he lives.
commonMistakes.reason: 名词性从句要用陈述语序，不能用疑问语序does he live

commonMistakes.wrong: Can you tell me when will the train arrive?
commonMistakes.correct: Can you tell me when the train will arrive?
commonMistakes.reason: 宾语从句要用陈述语序will the train arrive改成the train will arrive

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: 名词性从句=陈述语序！疑问词放前面，后面跟主语+谓语。千万别用疑问语序！

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: 宾语从句的时态一致
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: 宾语从句的时态要跟着主句走：主句是现在时或将来时，从句该用什么用什么；主句是过去时，从句要变成对应的过去时态。但如果是客观真理，不管主句什么时态，从句都用一般现在时。
rules: 主句是现在时/将来时 → 从句时态根据实际情况定
主句是过去时 → 从句变成对应的过去时态
客观真理在从句中永远用一般现在时，不受主句影响
一般现在时 → 一般过去时；现在进行时 → 过去进行时
一般将来时(will) → 过去将来时(would)；现在完成时 → 过去完成时

examples.en: He says that he is busy.
examples.cn: 他说他很忙。（主句现在时，从句也现在时）

examples.en: He said that he was busy.
examples.cn: 他说他很忙。（主句过去时，从句变过去时）

examples.en: She told me she would come the next day.
examples.cn: 她告诉我她第二天会来。（will→would）

examples.en: The teacher told us that the earth is round.
examples.cn: 老师告诉我们地球是圆的。（客观真理，不受主句过去时影响）

examples.en: He said he had finished his homework.
examples.cn: 他说他已经完成了作业。（现在完成→过去完成）

commonMistakes.wrong: He said that he is busy yesterday.
commonMistakes.correct: He said that he was busy yesterday.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句said是过去时，从句也要用过去时was

commonMistakes.wrong: The teacher told us that the earth was round.
commonMistakes.correct: The teacher told us that the earth is round.
commonMistakes.reason: 地球是圆的是客观真理，不受主句时态影响，用一般现在时is

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: 主句过去时→从句退一步变过去时态。但客观真理永远是现在时！

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: 同位语从句
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: 同位语从句就是用一个从句来解释一个名词的具体内容。比如'他明天来的消息让我们高兴'中，'他明天来'是'消息'的内容。常跟在fact/news/idea/hope/question等名词后面，用that引导。
rules: 常跟在fact, news, idea, hope, question, truth, belief等抽象名词后
通常用that引导，that不充当成分但不可省略
也可用whether/when/where/why/how等引导
同位语从句解释名词的内容，定语从句修饰名词的特征
同位语从句中的that是连词，定语从句中的that是关系代词（作成分）

examples.en: The news that he won the prize excited everyone.
examples.cn: 他获奖的消息让大家兴奋。

examples.en: The fact that she passed the exam is true.
examples.cn: 她通过考试这个事实是真的。

examples.en: I have no idea when he will come back.
examples.cn: 我不知道他什么时候回来。

examples.en: The question whether we should accept the offer remains.
examples.cn: 我们是否应该接受这个提议的问题仍然存在。

examples.en: The belief that hard work pays off is widely shared.
examples.cn: 努力会有回报这一信念被广泛认同。

commonMistakes.wrong: The news that he told me is exciting.
commonMistakes.correct: The news that he told me is exciting.
commonMistakes.reason: 注意：这里的that he told me是定语从句（that作told的宾语），不是同位语从句。同位语从句的that不作成分。

commonMistakes.wrong: The news he won the prize excited everyone.
commonMistakes.correct: The news that he won the prize excited everyone.
commonMistakes.reason: 同位语从句的that不可省略

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: 同位语从句=解释名词内容。that不省略、不作成分。和定语从句的区别：定语从句的that在从句中作主语或宾语。

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).name: what引导的名词性从句
名词性从句 (Noun Clause).plainLanguage: what在名词性从句中既当连接词又当句子成分（主语或宾语），意思是'...的东西/事情'。它可以引导主语从句、宾语从句、表语从句。和that的区别是：that不作成分，what必须作成分且有实际意义。
rules: what = the thing(s) that，在从句中充当主语、宾语、表语等成分
主语从句：What he said is true.（what作said的宾语）
宾语从句：I don't understand what you mean.（what作mean的宾语）
表语从句：This is what I want.（what作want的宾语）
what与that的区别：that不作成分无实义，what作成分有实义
what不能引导同位语从句（that才行）

examples.en: What he said made me angry.
examples.cn: 他说的话让我生气。（what作said的宾语，引导主语从句）

examples.en: I don't know what happened.
examples.cn: 我不知道发生了什么。（what作happened的主语，引导宾语从句）

examples.en: This is what I need.
examples.cn: 这就是我需要的。（what作need的宾语，引导表语从句）

examples.en: What matters most is your attitude.
examples.cn: 最重要的是你的态度。（what作matters的主语）

examples.en: Show me what you bought.
examples.cn: 给我看看你买了什么。

commonMistakes.wrong: That he said made me angry.
commonMistakes.correct: What he said made me angry.
commonMistakes.reason: 这里从句said缺宾语，需要what既连接又作宾语；that不作成分，用that的话从句不完整

commonMistakes.wrong: I don't know that happened.
commonMistakes.correct: I don't know what happened.
commonMistakes.reason: happen是不及物动词，从句缺主语，需要what作主语；that不作成分

commonMistakes.wrong: This is that I want.
commonMistakes.correct: This is what I want.
commonMistakes.reason: 从句want缺宾语，需要what作宾语；that不作成分

名词性从句 (Noun Clause).tips: what=the thing that，既当连接词又作成分（主/宾/表）。从句缺成分用what，不缺成分用that。what不能引导同位语从句！

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 时间状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 时间状语从句就是告诉你'什么时候'的从句。用when（当...时）、while（当...期间）、as（一边...一边）、before（在...之前）、after（在...之后）、since（自从）、until（直到）、as soon as（一...就）等连接。
rules: when：当...时（可接短暂性或延续性动作）
while：当...期间（接延续性动作，常用进行时）
as：一边...一边/随着
before：在...之前；after：在...之后
since：自从（主句现在完成时，从句一般过去时）
until/till：直到（not...until = 直到...才）
as soon as / the moment / directly：一...就

examples.en: When I arrived, he was reading.
examples.cn: 我到达时他正在看书。

examples.en: While she was cooking, I was cleaning.
examples.cn: 她做饭时我在打扫。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
examples.cn: 我一到就给你打电话。

examples.en: He didn't leave until the rain stopped.
examples.cn: 直到雨停了他才离开。

examples.en: It has been three years since I came here.
examples.cn: 自从我来这里已经三年了。

commonMistakes.wrong: While I arrived, he was reading.
commonMistakes.correct: When I arrived, he was reading.
commonMistakes.reason: while需要延续性动作，arrive是短暂性动作，应该用when

commonMistakes.wrong: I didn't go to bed until my mother came back.
commonMistakes.correct: I didn't go to bed until my mother came back.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。not...until表示'直到...才'

commonMistakes.wrong: I will call you as soon as I will arrive.
commonMistakes.correct: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
commonMistakes.reason: 时间状语从句中用一般现在时表将来，不能直接用will arrive

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: 主将从现：主句将来时，时间状语从句用一般现在时！while接延续性动作，when两者皆可。not...until='直到...才'。

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 原因状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 原因状语从句就是说明'为什么'。用because（因为）、since（既然）、as（因为/由于）连接。because语气最强，可以回答why的提问；since和as语气弱，表示大家都知道的原因。
rules: because：语气最强，可回答why提问，从句可放在主句前或后
since：表示大家都知道的原因，'既然'，从句一般在主句前
as：语气最弱，表示显然的原因
for：并列连词，不能放句首，表示补充说明原因
because of + 名词/名词短语（不是从句）

examples.en: I didn't go to school because I was sick.
examples.cn: 我没去上学因为我病了。

examples.en: Since you are here, let's start.
examples.cn: 既然你在这儿，我们开始吧。

examples.en: As it was getting dark, we hurried home.
examples.cn: 因为天快黑了，我们赶紧回家。

examples.en: He must be tired, for he worked all night.
examples.cn: 他一定很累，因为他工作了一整夜。

examples.en: She cried because of the sad movie.
examples.cn: 她因为那部悲伤的电影而哭了。

commonMistakes.wrong: Because I was sick, so I didn't go to school.
commonMistakes.correct: Because I was sick, I didn't go to school.
commonMistakes.reason: because和so不能同时使用，保留一个即可

commonMistakes.wrong: The reason is because he was late.
commonMistakes.correct: The reason is that he was late.
commonMistakes.reason: reason后面应该用that引导表语从句，不能用because（the reason is that是固定结构）

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: because和so不能同时用！中文'因为...所以...'英语只能选一个。the reason后面跟that不跟because。

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 条件状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 条件状语从句说'如果...就...'。用if（如果）、unless（如果不/除非）、as long as（只要）、in case（万一）等。最重要的规则：主句用将来时，从句用现在时表将来（主将从现）。
rules: if：如果
unless = if not：除非/如果不
as long as：只要
in case：万一（以防）
主将从现：主句将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来
条件状语从句中不用will表将来

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家里。

examples.en: You won't pass the exam unless you study hard.
examples.cn: 除非你努力学习，否则你不会通过考试。

examples.en: As long as you are happy, I am happy.
examples.cn: 只要你开心，我就开心。

examples.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples.cn: 带上伞以防下雨。

examples.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
examples.cn: 如果你加热冰，它就会融化。（客观真理）

commonMistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, I will stay at home.
commonMistakes.correct: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
commonMistakes.reason: 条件状语从句中用一般现在时表将来，不能用will

commonMistakes.wrong: Unless you don't study hard, you will fail.
commonMistakes.correct: Unless you study hard, you will fail.
commonMistakes.reason: unless本身已经含有否定意义（=if not），不需要再加否定词don't

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: 条件从句=主将从现！主句will，从句用现在时。unless=if not，别再加否定！

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 让步状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 让步状语从句就是'虽然...但是...'或'尽管...'。用although/though（虽然）、even though（即使）、no matter what/how（无论什么/怎样）、while（虽然）等。记住英语中although和but不能同时用！
rules: although/though：虽然（不能与but连用，可与yet连用）
even though/even if：即使
no matter + 疑问词 = 疑问词-ever：无论...
while：虽然（放句首）
as引导让步从句（倒装语序）：Tired as he was, he kept working.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
examples.cn: 虽然在下雨，我们还是出去了。

examples.en: Even though she was tired, she kept working.
examples.cn: 即使很累，她还是继续工作。

examples.en: No matter what happens, I will support you.
examples.cn: 无论发生什么，我都支持你。

examples.en: However hard he tried, he couldn't pass.
examples.cn: 无论他多么努力，都没能通过。

examples.en: Child as he is, he knows a lot.
examples.cn: 虽然他还是个孩子，他知道很多。（as引导，倒装）

commonMistakes.wrong: Although it was raining, but we went out.
commonMistakes.correct: Although it was raining, we went out.
commonMistakes.reason: although和but不能同时使用，中文可以说'虽然...但是...'，英语只能用一个

commonMistakes.wrong: No matter what you say it.
commonMistakes.correct: No matter what you say.
commonMistakes.reason: what在从句中作say的宾语，后面不能再加it

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: although/though和but不能同时出现！no matter+疑问词=疑问词-ever。as引导让步要倒装（名词/形容词/副词提前）。

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 目的与结果状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 目的状语从句说'为了...'，用so that（为了/以便）、in order that（为了）。结果状语从句说'如此...以至于...'，用so...that、such...that。记住so修饰形容词/副词，such修饰名词。
rules: so that / in order that + 从句（目的，从句中常含can/could/may/might/will/would）
so + 形容词/副词 + that + 从句（结果）
such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that + 从句（结果）
so + much/little/few/many + 名词 + that（特殊结构）
so that也可表结果（看语境），表目的时常有can/could等情态动词

examples.en: I got up early so that I could catch the bus.
examples.cn: 我早起是为了赶上公交车。（目的）

examples.en: He is so tall that he can reach the shelf.
examples.cn: 他如此高以至于能够到架子。（结果）

examples.en: It was such a good movie that I watched it twice.
examples.cn: 这电影太好了我看了两遍。（结果）

examples.en: She spoke loudly so that everyone could hear.
examples.cn: 她大声说话以便大家都能听到。（目的）

examples.en: There were so many people that we couldn't get in.
examples.cn: 人太多了我们进不去。（结果）

commonMistakes.wrong: He is such tall that he can reach the shelf.
commonMistakes.correct: He is so tall that he can reach the shelf.
commonMistakes.reason: tall是形容词没有名词，要用so...that；such后必须接名词

commonMistakes.wrong: It was so good movie that I watched it twice.
commonMistakes.correct: It was such a good movie that I watched it twice.
commonMistakes.reason: good movie是名词短语，要用such a good movie

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: so+形容词/副词+that，such+(a/an)+形容词+名词+that。特殊情况：so many/much/few/little+名词+that。

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).name: 方式与地点状语从句
状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).plainLanguage: 方式状语从句说'像...一样/按照...方式'，用as（像）、as if/though（好像）、the way（以...方式）。地点状语从句说'在哪里'，用where（哪里）、wherever（无论哪里）。
rules: as：按照...的方式/像...一样
as if / as though：好像（后面可用虚拟语气表示非真实情况）
the way (that)：以...方式
where：在...地方
wherever：无论在哪里

examples.en: Do as I tell you.
examples.cn: 按我说的做。

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.cn: 他说话好像什么都知道似的。

examples.en: Put the book where it was.
examples.cn: 把书放回原处。

examples.en: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
examples.cn: 无论你去哪里，我都跟着你。

examples.en: She cooks the way her mother does.
examples.cn: 她做饭的方式和她妈妈一样。

commonMistakes.wrong: Do like I tell you.
commonMistakes.correct: Do as I tell you.
commonMistakes.reason: 引导方式状语从句用as，like是介词不引导从句（口语中可用，但不规范）

commonMistakes.wrong: He talks as if he knows everything.
commonMistakes.correct: He talks as if he knew everything.
commonMistakes.reason: as if后面如果表示非真实（他不可能什么都知道），要用虚拟语气knew

状语从句 (Adverbial Clause).tips: 方式用as/as if，地点用where/wherever。as if后面表非真实要用虚拟！

不定式 (Infinitive).name: 不定式作主语和宾语
不定式 (Infinitive).plainLanguage: 不定式（to + 动词原形）可以当句子主语或宾语。比如'学英语很重要'就是To learn English is important。更常用it作形式主语：It is important to learn English。有些动词后只能接不定式作宾语，如want/decide/hope/plan等。
rules: 不定式作主语：To do sth is... 或 It is ... to do sth（更常用）
不定式作宾语：want/decide/hope/plan/expect/refuse/promise/agree + to do
不定式作宾语补足语：want/tell/ask/allow sb to do sth
It takes sb + 时间 + to do sth：花费某人多少时间做某事
It is + 形容词 + for sb to do sth / of sb to do sth

examples.en: To learn English well is important.
examples.cn: 学好英语很重要。

examples.en: It is important to learn English well.
examples.cn: 学好英语很重要。（it形式主语）

examples.en: I want to travel around the world.
examples.cn: 我想环游世界。

examples.en: It took me two hours to finish the work.
examples.cn: 我花了两小时完成工作。

examples.en: It is kind of you to help me.
examples.cn: 你真好，帮我。

commonMistakes.wrong: I want travel around the world.
commonMistakes.correct: I want to travel around the world.
commonMistakes.reason: want后面接不定式to travel，不能直接用动词原形

commonMistakes.wrong: It is important learn English well.
commonMistakes.correct: It is important to learn English well.
commonMistakes.reason: it形式主语后面要用to do不定式作真正主语

不定式 (Infinitive).tips: to do可以当主语和宾语。常用It is... to do结构。want/decide/hope/plan后必接to do。of sb用表示品质的形容词（kind/clever/foolish），for sb用其他。

不定式 (Infinitive).name: 不定式作定语
不定式 (Infinitive).plainLanguage: 不定式可以放在名词后面当定语，表示'要做的/需要做的'。比如'有很多事要做'是I have a lot of work to do。如果不定式是不及物动词，后面要加介词。
rules: 不定式放在名词/代词后作定语：名词 + to do
不定式与被修饰名词有动宾关系：I have a letter to write（write a letter）
不定式是不及物动词时需加介词：a room to live in
不定式与被修饰名词有主谓关系：the first man to arrive
用于序数词/最高级后：the best way to do it

examples.en: I have a lot of homework to do.
examples.cn: 我有很多作业要做。

examples.en: She is the first person to arrive.
examples.cn: 她是最早到的人。

examples.en: He needs a room to live in.
examples.cn: 他需要一个住的地方。

examples.en: Do you have anything to say?
examples.cn: 你有什么要说的吗？

examples.en: This is the best way to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 这是解决问题的最佳方法。

commonMistakes.wrong: He needs a room to live.
commonMistakes.correct: He needs a room to live in.
commonMistakes.reason: live是不及物动词，不能直接接room作宾语，需要加介词in

commonMistakes.wrong: I have a letter to write it.
commonMistakes.correct: I have a letter to write.
commonMistakes.reason: 不定式to write已经和letter有动宾关系，不能再加宾语it

不定式 (Infinitive).tips: 名词+to do作定语。不及物动词要加介词（live in, sit on, talk about）。不定式和名词有动宾关系时不再加宾语。

不定式 (Infinitive).name: 不定式作状语和补语
不定式 (Infinitive).plainLanguage: 不定式可以当状语，表示目的（为了）、结果（以至于）、原因。也可以当宾语补足语，补充说明宾语要做什么，如tell sb to do sth。注意有些动词后省略to，如make sb do。
rules: 目的状语：to do / in order to do / so as to do（为了）
结果状语：too...to do（太...而不能）；enough to do（足够...可以）；only to do（结果却，表意外）
宾语补足语：tell/ask/want/allow sb to do sth
使役动词make/let/have sb do sth（省略to）→ 被动时补回to：be made to do
感官动词see/hear sb do sth（省略to，表全过程）→ 被动时补回to

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.
examples.cn: 我早起为了赶上首班车。（目的）

examples.en: He is too young to go to school.
examples.cn: 他太小不能上学。（结果）

examples.en: She told me to wait here.
examples.cn: 她让我在这里等。（宾补）

examples.en: The boss made them work overtime.
examples.cn: 老板让他们加班。（省略to）

examples.en: He hurried to the station, only to find the train had left.
examples.cn: 他赶到车站，却发现火车已经走了。（结果，意外）

commonMistakes.wrong: The boss made them to work overtime.
commonMistakes.correct: The boss made them work overtime.
commonMistakes.reason: 使役动词make后接不带to的不定式，不能加to

commonMistakes.wrong: I told him wait here.
commonMistakes.correct: I told him to wait here.
commonMistakes.reason: tell后面接带to的不定式to wait，不能省略to

不定式 (Infinitive).tips: 目的用to do/in order to do。too...to=太...不能。make/let/have省to，tell/ask/want不省to。被动时to要补回！

不定式 (Infinitive).name: 不定式的时态和语态
不定式 (Infinitive).plainLanguage: 不定式也有时态变化：to do（一般），to be doing（进行），to have done（完成，表示动作发生在谓语之前）。被动形式是to be done（一般被动），to have been done（完成被动）。
rules: 一般式：to do（与谓语同时或之后发生）
进行式：to be doing（谓语发生时正在进行的动作）
完成式：to have done（在谓语之前已发生的动作）
被动一般式：to be done
被动完成式：to have been done

examples.en: He seems to know the answer.
examples.cn: 他似乎知道答案。（同时）

examples.en: He seems to be reading something.
examples.cn: 他似乎正在读什么。（进行）

examples.en: He is said to have written three books.
examples.cn: 据说他已经写了三本书。（完成，write发生在is said之前）

examples.en: The meeting to be held tomorrow is important.
examples.cn: 明天要开的会议很重要。（被动，将来）

examples.en: The project is reported to have been completed.
examples.cn: 据报道项目已完成。（被动完成）

commonMistakes.wrong: He is said to write three books.
commonMistakes.correct: He is said to have written three books.
commonMistakes.reason: 写书发生在is said之前，应该用完成式to have written

commonMistakes.wrong: The problem to solve is difficult.
commonMistakes.correct: The problem to be solved is difficult.
commonMistakes.reason: 问题是'被'解决的，应该用被动式to be solved

不定式 (Infinitive).tips: to do=同时/之后，to be doing=正在进行，to have done=之前已完成。被动加be/been即可。

不定式 (Infinitive).name: 不定式符号to的省略
不定式 (Infinitive).plainLanguage: 有些动词后面跟不定式时，to可以省掉，直接用动词原形。使役动词make/let/have后面跟sb do sth；感官动词see/hear/watch/notice/feel后面也是sb do sth。但变被动语态后，省掉的to要补回来！
rules: 使役动词make/let/have + sb + do sth（省to）：He made me cry.
感官动词see/hear/watch/notice/feel + sb + do sth（省to）：I saw him enter.
would rather (not) do sth：宁愿（不）做某事
had better (not) do sth：最好（不）做某事
Why (not) do sth?：为什么（不）做某事
help (to) do sth：to可省可不省
变被动语态时补回to：be made to do, be seen to do

examples.en: The boss made him work overtime.
examples.cn: 老板让他加班。（work前省to）

examples.en: I saw him cross the street.
examples.cn: 我看见他过了马路。（cross前省to）

examples.en: He was made to work overtime.
examples.cn: 他被要求加班。（被动补回to）

examples.en: You had better not go out alone at night.
examples.cn: 你晚上最好别单独出门。

examples.en: Why not ask the teacher for help?
examples.cn: 为什么不向老师求助呢？

commonMistakes.wrong: The boss made him to work overtime.
commonMistakes.correct: The boss made him work overtime.
commonMistakes.reason: 使役动词make后接不带to的不定式，直接用work

commonMistakes.wrong: He was made work overtime.
commonMistakes.correct: He was made to work overtime.
commonMistakes.reason: 变被动语态后要补回省略的to，变成be made to do

commonMistakes.wrong: I saw him to cross the street.
commonMistakes.correct: I saw him cross the street.
commonMistakes.reason: 感官动词see后接不带to的不定式，直接用cross

不定式 (Infinitive).tips: make/let/have + sb do（省to），see/hear/watch/feel + sb do（省to）。但被动语态要补to：be made to do, be seen to do！would rather/had better/why not后也省to。

动名词 (Gerund).name: 动名词的用法
动名词 (Gerund).plainLanguage: 动名词（动词+ing）可以当名词用——作主语、宾语、表语。有些动词后面只能接动名词不能接不定式，如enjoy/finish/practice/mind/suggest/avoid/consider等。介词后面也必须用动名词。
rules: 动名词作主语：Swimming is good for your health.
动名词作宾语：enjoy/finish/practice/mind/suggest/avoid/consider + doing
动名词作介词宾语：be good at doing, be interested in doing, look forward to doing
It's no use doing sth / There is no doing sth（固定句型）
动名词作表语：My hobby is reading.

examples.en: Swimming is good for your health.
examples.cn: 游泳对你的健康有益。

examples.en: I enjoy reading novels.
examples.cn: 我喜欢读小说。

examples.en: She finished cleaning the room.
examples.cn: 她打扫完房间了。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
examples.cn: 我期待见到你。

examples.en: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
examples.cn: 覆水难收。

commonMistakes.wrong: I enjoy to read novels.
commonMistakes.correct: I enjoy reading novels.
commonMistakes.reason: enjoy后面只能接动名词doing，不能接不定式to do

commonMistakes.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you.
commonMistakes.correct: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
commonMistakes.reason: look forward to中的to是介词，后面要接动名词seeing，不是动词原形
