commonMistakes.wrong: She finished to clean the room.
commonMistakes.correct: She finished cleaning the room.
commonMistakes.reason: finish后面只能接动名词cleaning，不能接不定式

动名词 (Gerund).tips: 只接doing的动词：enjoy/finish/practice/mind/suggest/avoid/consider/give up/can't help。介词后必接doing！look forward to doing不是to do！
relatedCategories: 动名词与不定式的区别

动名词 (Gerund).name: 动名词与不定式的区别
动名词 (Gerund).plainLanguage: 有些动词后面既可以接to do也可以接doing，但意思不同。比如remember to do（记得要做）vs remember doing（记得做过）；stop to do（停下来去做）vs stop doing（停止做）。还有一些动词接两者意思差不多，如like/love/start/begin。
rules: remember to do: 记得要做（还没做）；remember doing: 记得做过（已发生）
forget to do: 忘了要做；forget doing: 忘了做过
stop to do: 停下来去做另一件事；stop doing: 停止正在做的事
try to do: 努力做；try doing: 试着做看看
mean to do: 打算做；mean doing: 意味着
regret to do: 遗憾要做；regret doing: 后悔做过

examples.en: Remember to lock the door.
examples.cn: 记得锁门。（还没锁）

examples.en: I remember locking the door.
examples.cn: 我记得锁了门。（已锁）

examples.en: He stopped to smoke.
examples.cn: 他停下来去抽烟。（去抽烟）

examples.en: He stopped smoking.
examples.cn: 他戒烟了。（不抽了）

examples.en: I regret to tell you that you failed.
examples.cn: 我很遗憾地告诉你你不及格。

commonMistakes.wrong: I remember to meet him before.
commonMistakes.correct: I remember meeting him before.
commonMistakes.reason: 已经见过面了（已发生），应该用remember doing

commonMistakes.wrong: He stopped smoking to have a rest.
commonMistakes.correct: He stopped to have a rest.
commonMistakes.reason: 停下来休息=stop to do，不是stop doing

动名词 (Gerund).tips: to do=还没做/去做；doing=已经做了/正在做。remember/forget/stop/try/mean/regret后接两者意思不同，一定要记住！

动名词 (Gerund).name: 动名词的复合结构
动名词 (Gerund).plainLanguage: 动名词前面可以加上自己的逻辑主语，构成复合结构，说明是谁做的事。比如'他迟到让我们担心'是His being late worried us。正式语体用物主代词或名词所有格，口语中也用宾格。
rules: 结构：逻辑主语 + 动名词（doing）
作主语：逻辑主语用物主代词/名词所有格（his/Tom's + doing）
作宾语：可用宾格/普通格（him/Tom + doing），也可用所有格
无生命名词用普通格：The rain coming made us stay home.
时间名词可用所有格：a week's delay, today's meeting

examples.en: His coming late worried us.
examples.cn: 他来晚了让我们担心。（his being late作主语）

examples.en: Do you mind my opening the window?
examples.cn: 你介意我开窗吗？（my opening作宾语）

examples.en: I remember Tom's telling me about it.
examples.cn: 我记得汤姆跟我说过这事。

examples.en: The baby crying kept me awake all night.
examples.cn: 婴儿哭闹让我整晚没睡。（无生命名词用普通格）

examples.en: There is no hope of their winning the game.
examples.cn: 他们没有赢比赛的希望。

commonMistakes.wrong: Him coming late worried us.
commonMistakes.correct: His coming late worried us.
commonMistakes.reason: 动名词复合结构作主语时，逻辑主语用所有格his，不用宾格him

commonMistakes.wrong: Do you mind me opening the window?
commonMistakes.correct: Do you mind my opening the window?
commonMistakes.reason: 正式语体中作宾语时也用所有格my，me是口语形式

动名词 (Gerund).tips: 动名词复合结构=逻辑主语+doing。作主语用所有格(his/Tom's)，作宾语可用宾格或所有格。无生命名词用普通格(The rain coming)。

分词 (Participle).name: 现在分词的用法
分词 (Participle).plainLanguage: 现在分词（动词+ing）可以当形容词用，表示'主动的/正在进行的'。比如'an exciting match'（令人兴奋的比赛），'the girl reading a book'（正在看书的女孩）。它表示主动和进行。
rules: 现在分词表示主动和进行
作定语：a boring movie（令人无聊的电影），the boy standing there
作表语：The news is exciting.（令人兴奋的）
作宾补：I saw him crossing the street.（看到他正在过马路）
作状语：Walking in the park, I met a friend.（=When I was walking...）

examples.en: The exciting news made everyone happy.
examples.cn: 令人兴奋的消息让大家开心。

examples.en: The girl reading a book is my sister.
examples.cn: 正在看书的女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: The movie is boring.
examples.cn: 这部电影很无聊。

examples.en: I saw him crossing the street.
examples.cn: 我看到他正在过马路。

examples.en: Hearing the news, she burst into tears.
examples.cn: 听到消息，她大哭起来。

commonMistakes.wrong: The excited news made everyone happy.
commonMistakes.correct: The exciting news made everyone happy.
commonMistakes.reason: 消息是令人兴奋的（主动），用exciting；excited是'感到兴奋的'，修饰人

commonMistakes.wrong: The girl reads a book is my sister.
commonMistakes.correct: The girl reading a book is my sister.
commonMistakes.reason: 作定语修饰girl应该用现在分词reading，不能用动词reads

分词 (Participle).tips: 现在分词=主动+进行。-ing修饰物（令人...的），-ed修饰人（感到...的）。如exciting movie vs excited audience。
relatedCategories: 动名词与现在分词区别

分词 (Participle).name: 过去分词的用法
分词 (Participle).plainLanguage: 过去分词（动词的过去分词形式）也可以当形容词用，但表示'被动的/完成的'。比如'a broken window'（被打碎的窗户），'the excited people'（兴奋的人们）。和现在分词的区别是：现在分词主动进行，过去分词被动完成。
rules: 过去分词表示被动和完成
作定语：a broken cup（打碎的杯子），the language spoken here
作表语：He is interested in science.（感到感兴趣的）
作宾补：I had my hair cut.（让头发被剪）
作状语：Given more time, I could do better.（=If I were given...）

examples.en: The broken glass is on the floor.
examples.cn: 碎玻璃在地上。

examples.en: He was surprised at the result.
examples.cn: 他对结果感到惊讶。

examples.en: I had my bike repaired.
examples.cn: 我让人修了我的自行车。

examples.en: Written in English, the book is easy to read.
examples.cn: 这本书用英语写的，容易读。

examples.en: The excited children ran to the playground.
examples.cn: 兴奋的孩子们跑到操场上。

commonMistakes.wrong: The boring people left the theater.
commonMistakes.correct: The bored people left the theater.
commonMistakes.reason: 人感到无聊用bored，不是boring；boring修饰令人无聊的事物

commonMistakes.wrong: I had my bike repair.
commonMistakes.correct: I had my bike repaired.
commonMistakes.reason: have sth done结构中，过去分词表示被动（让某事被做），用repaired不是repair

分词 (Participle).tips: 过去分词=被动+完成。-ing修饰物（令人...），-ed修饰人（感到...）。have sth done=让某事被别人做。

分词 (Participle).name: 分词作状语
分词 (Participle).plainLanguage: 分词可以当状语，表示时间、原因、条件、让步等。现在分词表主动，过去分词表被动。比如'走在街上，我遇到了朋友'是Walking in the street, I met a friend（主动走路用walking）。'被给予更多时间，我能做得更好'用Given more time（被动用given）。
rules: 现在分词作状语：逻辑主语与主句主语一致且为主动关系
过去分词作状语：逻辑主语与主句主语一致且为被动关系
完成式：Having done sth, ...（先发生的动作）
分词作状语时其逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
否定形式：Not having done / Not doing

examples.en: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
examples.cn: 走在街上，我遇到了老朋友。

examples.en: Given more time, I could do it better.
examples.cn: 多给些时间，我能做得更好。

examples.en: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
examples.cn: 做完作业后，他出去玩了。

examples.en: Not knowing what to do, he asked for help.
examples.cn: 不知道该怎么办，他求助了。

examples.en: Praised by the teacher, the student was very happy.
examples.cn: 被老师表扬，那个学生很开心。

commonMistakes.wrong: Walking along the street, an old friend met me.
commonMistakes.correct: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
commonMistakes.reason: walking的逻辑主语应该和主句主语一致，是I在走而不是an old friend在走

commonMistakes.wrong: Having finished his homework, it was time to play.
commonMistakes.correct: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
commonMistakes.reason: having finished的逻辑主语是he不是it，主句主语必须和分词逻辑主语一致

分词 (Participle).tips: 分词作状语，逻辑主语=主句主语！主动用doing，被动用done。先发生的用having done。否定加not在前。

分词 (Participle).name: 独立主格结构
分词 (Participle).plainLanguage: 独立主格就是'自带主语的分词结构'。普通分词作状语和主句共用主语，但独立主格有自己的主语。比如'The weather being fine, we went out'中weather是独立主格自己的主语。它不是完整的句子，只是补充说明。
rules: 结构：名词/代词 + 分词（现在分词或过去分词）
独立主格有自己的逻辑主语，与主句主语不同
可表时间、原因、条件、伴随等
名词 + doing（主动关系）/ 名词 + done（被动关系）
也可用名词 + 形容词/副词/介词短语/不定式

examples.en: The weather being fine, we went out for a picnic.
examples.cn: 天气好，我们出去野餐了。

examples.en: His homework finished, he went out to play.
examples.cn: 作业做完了，他出去玩了。

examples.en: The meeting over, everyone went home.
examples.cn: 会议结束了，大家都回家了。

examples.en: There being no bus, we had to walk home.
examples.cn: 没有公交车了，我们只好走路回家。

examples.en: He lay on the grass, his hands crossed behind his head.
examples.cn: 他躺在草地上，双手交叉在脑后。

commonMistakes.wrong: Weather being fine, we went out for a picnic.
commonMistakes.correct: The weather being fine, we went out for a picnic.
commonMistakes.reason: 独立主格中的名词需要有冠词等限定词，应是The weather being fine

commonMistakes.wrong: His homework finished, he went out to play.
commonMistakes.correct: His homework finished, he went out to play.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。homework和finish是被动关系，用过去分词finished

commonMistakes.wrong: There is no bus, we had to walk home.
commonMistakes.correct: There being no bus, we had to walk home.
commonMistakes.reason: 两句之间没有连词连接，应改为独立主格结构There being no bus

分词 (Participle).tips: 独立主格=自己的主语+分词/形容词/副词。和分词作状语的区别：分词作状语和主句共用主语，独立主格有自己的主语。

分词 (Participle).name: 过去分词作后置定语
分词 (Participle).plainLanguage: 过去分词可以放在名词后面当定语，相当于一个定语从句的简写版。比如'the book written by him'就是'the book that was written by him'的简写。及物动词的过去分词表被动，不及物动词的过去分词表完成。
rules: 及物动词的过去分词作后置定语：表被动（the book written by him）
不及物动词的过去分词作后置定语：表完成（fallen leaves = 已落下的叶子）
单个过去分词可前置：a broken window, a retired teacher
过去分词短语必须后置：the novel written by Lu Xun
可还原为定语从句：the boy praised by the teacher = the boy who was praised by the teacher

examples.en: The book written by him is a bestseller.
examples.cn: 他写的书是畅销书。（written by him = that was written by him）

examples.en: Fallen leaves covered the ground.
examples.cn: 落叶铺满了地面。（fallen = 已落下的，不及物动词表完成）

examples.en: The boy injured in the accident is my classmate.
examples.cn: 在事故中受伤的男孩是我同学。

examples.en: This is a broken cup.
examples.cn: 这是个破损的杯子。（单个过去分词前置）

examples.en: The language spoken here is English.
examples.cn: 这里说的语言是英语。（spoken here = that is spoken here）

commonMistakes.wrong: The book writing by him is a bestseller.
commonMistakes.correct: The book written by him is a bestseller.
commonMistakes.reason: 书是'被'写的，用过去分词written表被动，不用现在分词writing

commonMistakes.wrong: The falling leaves covered the ground.
commonMistakes.correct: The fallen leaves covered the ground.
commonMistakes.reason: 已落下的叶子用fallen（完成），falling表示'正在落下的'

分词 (Participle).tips: 过去分词作定语=被动+完成。及物动词的done表被动（written=被写的），不及物动词的done表完成（fallen=已落下的）。单个前置，短语后置！

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).name: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气
if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 当我们说一个和现在不一样的假设时，就用虚拟语气。比如'如果我是你，我就不会那么做'——我不是你，所以用虚拟。结构是：if + 一般过去时（be动词全用were），主句用would/should/could/might + 动词原形。
rules: 从句：一般过去时（be动词一律用were，不分人称）
主句：would/should/could/might + 动词原形
表示与现在事实相反的假设
if从句中如果有were/had/should，可省略if，将were/had/should提至主语前（倒装）
if从句的were在口语中第一/三人称单数也可用was，但正式场合用were

examples.en: If I were you, I would not do that.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我就不会那样做。

examples.en: If he had time, he would help us.
examples.cn: 如果他有时间，他会帮我们。

examples.en: If I were a bird, I could fly.
examples.cn: 如果我是一只鸟，我就能飞。

examples.en: If she knew the truth, she would be angry.
examples.cn: 如果她知道真相，她会生气的。

examples.en: Were I you, I would study harder. (省略if倒装)
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我会更努力学习。

commonMistakes.wrong: If I am you, I would not do that.
commonMistakes.correct: If I were you, I would not do that.
commonMistakes.reason: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，if从句用一般过去时，be动词用were不能用am或is

commonMistakes.wrong: If I were you, I will not do that.
commonMistakes.correct: If I were you, I would not do that.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句也要用虚拟语气，用would而不是will

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).tips: 现在虚拟：if+过去时（were全用），主句would+原形。'如果我是你'就是If I were you，记住were不变。
relatedCategories: 与过去事实相反的虚拟
与将来事实相反的虚拟

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).name: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气
if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 当我们后悔过去没做的事时用这个。比如'如果我当时学了，就能通过了'——当时没学，是假设。结构是：if + 过去完成时（had done），主句用would/should/could/might + have + 过去分词。
rules: 从句：过去完成时（had + 过去分词）
主句：would/should/could/might + have + 过去分词
表示与过去事实相反的假设
省略if的倒装：Had + 主语 + 过去分词, 主句...
主句的would have done表示对过去的虚拟推测

examples.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
examples.cn: 如果我当时更努力学习，就能通过考试了。

examples.en: If he had known the truth, he would have told us.
examples.cn: 如果他当时知道真相，他会告诉我们的。

examples.en: If she had taken the medicine, she would have gotten better.
examples.cn: 如果她当时吃了药，就会好起来的。

examples.en: Had I known it earlier, I would have helped you.
examples.cn: 如果我早点知道，我就会帮你了。（倒装）

examples.en: If it had not rained, we would have gone out.
examples.cn: 如果不下雨，我们就出去了。

commonMistakes.wrong: If I studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: 与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，if从句要用过去完成时had studied，不是一般过去时studied

commonMistakes.wrong: If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句也要用对应的过去虚拟形式would have passed，不能用would pass

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).tips: 过去虚拟：if+had done，主句would have done。两个都用过去完成相关形式！Had开头可省if。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与将来事实相反的虚拟

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).name: 与将来事实相反的虚拟语气
if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 当我们预测将来不太可能发生的事时用这个。结构是：if + 一般过去时/should do/were to do，主句用would/should/could/might + 动词原形。三种从句形式中，were to do最不可能，should do可能性稍大。
rules: 从句形式一：一般过去时（如rained）
从句形式二：should + 动词原形（如should rain）
从句形式三：were to + 动词原形（如were to rain）
主句：would/should/could/might + 动词原形
should do形式也可用于第一人称条件句（表万一）

examples.en: If it rained tomorrow, the match would be canceled.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，比赛就会取消。

examples.en: If it should rain tomorrow, we would stay at home.
examples.cn: 万一明天下雨，我们就待在家。

examples.en: If the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.
examples.cn: 就算太阳从西边升起，我也不会改变主意。

examples.en: If you were to fail, what would you do?
examples.cn: 万一你失败了，你会怎么办？

examples.en: Should it rain tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.
examples.cn: 万一天下雨，我们就取消旅行。（倒装）

commonMistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, the match would be canceled.
commonMistakes.correct: If it rained tomorrow, the match would be canceled.
commonMistakes.reason: 与将来虚拟的if从句不能用will，要用一般过去时rained/should rain/were to rain

commonMistakes.wrong: If it were to rain tomorrow, the match is canceled.
commonMistakes.correct: If it were to rain tomorrow, the match would be canceled.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句要用虚拟语气would be canceled，不能用一般现在时is canceled

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).tips: 将来虚拟从句三选一：过去时/should do/were to do，主句永远would+原形。should开头可省if。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与过去事实相反的虚拟

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).name: 混合条件句（错综时间虚拟）
if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 有时候if从句和主句的时间不一样，比如从句说过去的事，主句说现在的影响。这时各自按自己的时间用对应虚拟形式。比如'如果我当时学了，现在就不会这么惨了'——从句过去虚拟，主句现在虚拟。
rules: 从句和主句时间不一致时，各自用对应时态的虚拟形式
从句过去 + 主句现在：if + had done, would + do
从句现在 + 主句过去：if + did/were, would have done
必须根据上下文判断各自的虚拟时间
判断方法：看从句和主句分别描述什么时间的事

examples.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
examples.cn: 如果我当初学医，现在就是医生了。（从句过去，主句现在）

examples.en: If he were rich, he would have bought the house last year.
examples.cn: 如果他有钱，去年就买那房子了。（从句现在，主句过去）

examples.en: If I were you, I would have accepted the offer yesterday.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，昨天就接受那个提议了。

examples.en: Had she been more careful, she would not make mistakes now.
examples.cn: 如果她当初更仔细，现在就不会犯错了。

examples.en: If you had told me earlier, I would know what to do now.
examples.cn: 如果你早点告诉我，我现在就知道该怎么办了。

commonMistakes.wrong: If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
commonMistakes.correct: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句描述现在（now），应该用现在虚拟would be，不能用过去虚拟would have been

commonMistakes.wrong: If he were rich, he would buy the house last year.
commonMistakes.correct: If he were rich, he would have bought the house last year.
commonMistakes.reason: 主句描述过去（last year），应该用过去虚拟would have bought，不能用would buy

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).tips: 混合条件句=从句和主句各用各的虚拟时态！看时间状语判断是过去还是现在。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与过去事实相反的虚拟
与将来事实相反的虚拟

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).name: if省略时的倒装虚拟语气
if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 在虚拟语气中，如果if从句里有were、had或should，可以把if省掉，然后把were/had/should提到主语前面，像疑问句一样倒装。比如'如果我知道'Had I known = If I had known。这是比较正式高级的用法，让句子更简洁。
rules: 省略if的条件：从句中含有were/had/should
省略if后将were/had/should提至主语前（部分倒装）
与现在相反：Were I you, I would not do that.（= If I were you）
与过去相反：Had I known, I would have helped.（= If I had known）
与将来相反：Should it rain tomorrow, we would stay home.（= If it should rain）
主句的虚拟形式不变（would/could/should/might + do/have done）

examples.en: Were I you, I would accept the offer.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。（= If I were you）

examples.en: Had he known the truth, he would have told you.
examples.cn: 如果他知道真相，他就告诉你了。（= If he had known）

examples.en: Should it rain tomorrow, the match would be canceled.
examples.cn: 万一明天下雨，比赛就会取消。（= If it should rain）

examples.en: Had I had more time, I would have finished it.
examples.cn: 如果我有更多时间，我就完成了。

examples.en: Were she here, she would help us.
examples.cn: 如果她在这，她会帮我们的。

commonMistakes.wrong: If had I known the truth, I would have told you.
commonMistakes.correct: Had I known the truth, I would have told you.
commonMistakes.reason: 省略if后不再保留if，直接Had I known即可

commonMistakes.wrong: Did I know the answer, I would tell you.
commonMistakes.correct: Were I to know the answer, I would tell you.
commonMistakes.reason: 与现在相反的虚拟倒装用were（be动词），不用did；如用实义动词需Were I to do结构

if条件虚拟 (if Subjunctive).tips: 省if倒装：有were提were，有had提had，有should提should。Had I known = If I had known。省了if，倒装更高级！
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与过去事实相反的虚拟

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: wish后的虚拟语气
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: wish表示'真希望...就好了'，后面要用虚拟语气。对现在的愿望用过去时（be用were），对过去的愿望用过去完成时（had done），对将来的愿望用would/could + 动词原形。
rules: wish + 过去时（were）：对现在的愿望
wish + 过去完成时（had done）：对过去的愿望/遗憾
wish + would/could do：对将来的愿望
wish和hope的区别：wish表示不太可能实现的愿望，hope表示有可能实现的希望
If only + 虚拟语气 = wish + 虚拟语气（但更强烈）

examples.en: I wish I were taller.
examples.cn: 真希望我能高点。（现在）

examples.en: I wish I had studied harder.
examples.cn: 真希望我当时更努力。（过去）

examples.en: I wish it would stop raining.
examples.cn: 希望雨能停。（将来）

examples.en: She wishes she could fly.
examples.cn: 她希望自己能飞。

examples.en: If only I had listened to your advice!
examples.cn: 要是我听了你的建议就好了！

commonMistakes.wrong: I wish I am taller.
commonMistakes.correct: I wish I were taller.
commonMistakes.reason: wish后用虚拟语气，be动词用were，不能用现在时am

commonMistakes.wrong: I wish I would have studied harder.
commonMistakes.correct: I wish I had studied harder.
commonMistakes.reason: 对过去的遗憾用had done，不能用would have done

commonMistakes.wrong: I hope I were taller.
commonMistakes.correct: I wish I were taller.
commonMistakes.reason: hope后不接虚拟语气，不太可能实现的愿望用wish

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: wish+过去时=对现在，wish+had done=对过去，wish+would do=对将来。hope不接虚拟！If only=wish但更强烈。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与过去事实相反的虚拟

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: suggest等动词后的虚拟语气
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 有些动词表示'建议/命令/要求'时，后面的宾语从句用虚拟语气：(should) + 动词原形。should可以省略。这些动词有：suggest/advise/insist/demand/require/order/propose等。
rules: suggest/advise/insist/demand/require/order/propose + that + (should) + 动词原形
should可以省略，只剩动词原形
It is suggested/advised/required that + (should) + 动词原形
It is important/necessary/essential that + (should) + 动词原形
suggestion/advice/order/requirement等名词后的表语/同位语从句也用虚拟语气

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he (should) stop smoking.
examples.cn: 医生建议他戒烟。

examples.en: I insist that he (should) be present.
examples.cn: 我坚持要求他出席。

examples.en: It is required that everyone (should) wear a seat belt.
examples.cn: 要求每个人都系安全带。

examples.en: It is important that we (should) learn English well.
examples.cn: 学好英语很重要。

examples.en: My suggestion is that we (should) leave early.
examples.cn: 我的建议是我们早点出发。

commonMistakes.wrong: The doctor suggested that he stops smoking.
commonMistakes.correct: The doctor suggested that he (should) stop smoking.
commonMistakes.reason: suggest后的宾语从句用虚拟语气(should) + 动词原形stop，不能用第三人称单数stops

commonMistakes.wrong: It is important that we learn English well.
commonMistakes.correct: It is important that we (should) learn English well.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。learn是原形，符合虚拟语气要求。should可省略。

commonMistakes.wrong: I insist that he is present.
commonMistakes.correct: I insist that he (should) be present.
commonMistakes.reason: insist后的宾语从句用虚拟语气(should) be，不能用is

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: 建议命令要求类动词后的从句：(should)+原形！should可省。记住这些词：一坚持insist、二命令order/command、四建议suggest/advise/propose/recommend、五要求demand/require/request/desire/urge。

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: would rather的虚拟语气
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: would rather表示'宁愿'，后面可以接虚拟语气。对现在/将来的虚拟用过去时，对过去的虚拟用过去完成时。比如'我宁愿你昨天没来'用I would rather you hadn't come yesterday。
rules: would rather + 动词原形：表示自己宁愿做某事
would rather + 主语 + 过去时：表示对现在/将来的虚拟
would rather + 主语 + 过去完成时：表示对过去的虚拟
would rather do A than do B：宁愿做A不愿做B
would rather后面的从句主语和主句主语不同时用虚拟语气

examples.en: I would rather stay at home.
examples.cn: 我宁愿待在家。

examples.en: I would rather you didn't smoke.
examples.cn: 我宁愿你不抽烟。（现在/将来）

examples.en: I would rather you hadn't told her the truth.
examples.cn: 我宁愿你当时没告诉她真相。（过去）

examples.en: I would rather walk than take a bus.
examples.cn: 我宁愿走路也不坐公交。

examples.en: She would rather not talk about it.
examples.cn: 她宁愿不谈这件事。

commonMistakes.wrong: I would rather you don't smoke.
commonMistakes.correct: I would rather you didn't smoke.
commonMistakes.reason: would rather后接虚拟语气，对现在用过去时didn't，不能用现在时don't

commonMistakes.wrong: I would rather you hadn't come tomorrow.
commonMistakes.correct: I would rather you didn't come tomorrow.
commonMistakes.reason: tomorrow是将来时间，对将来用过去时didn't come，不能用过去完成时hadn't come

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: would rather+别人做：现在/将来用过去时，过去用过去完成时。would rather do A than do B=宁愿做A不做B。
relatedCategories: 与过去事实相反的虚拟

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: as if/though的虚拟语气
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: as if/though表示'好像'，当后面说的情况不太真实时用虚拟语气。对现在用过去时（be用were），对过去用过去完成时。如果可能是真实的，就不用虚拟。
rules: as if/though + 过去时（were）：表示与现在事实不符
as if/though + 过去完成时（had done）：表示与过去事实不符
如果后面情况可能是真实的，用陈述语气（不用虚拟）
It looks as if it is going to rain.（可能真的要下雨）
He talks as if he were the boss.（他不是老板，虚拟）

examples.en: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.cn: 他说话好像什么都知道。（现在虚拟）

examples.en: She looks as if she were sick.
examples.cn: 她看起来好像生病了。（现在虚拟）

examples.en: He talked as if he had seen a ghost.
examples.cn: 他说话好像见了鬼一样。（过去虚拟）

examples.en: It looks as if it is going to rain.
examples.cn: 看起来好像要下雨了。（可能真的下雨，用陈述语气）

examples.en: The child acts as though he were an adult.
examples.cn: 那孩子表现得好像大人一样。

commonMistakes.wrong: He talks as if he knows everything.
commonMistakes.correct: He talks as if he knew everything.
commonMistakes.reason: 他不可能什么都知道，表示与现在不符要用虚拟knew

commonMistakes.wrong: It looks as if it were going to rain.
commonMistakes.correct: It looks as if it is going to rain.
commonMistakes.reason: 可能真的要下雨（真实情况），不需要用虚拟语气，用一般现在时is going

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: as if后虚拟与否取决于真假：不太可能=虚拟（were/had done），可能真实=陈述（is/was）。be动词用were。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: It is (high) time的虚拟语气
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: It is time that...表示'该做某事了'，后面的从句用虚拟语气，动词用过去时。加high表示'早该做'了，语气更强。比如'该走了'是It is time we left。
rules: It is (high/about) time that + 主语 + 过去时
表示'该做某事了'（但实际上还没做）
be动词用were
也可以用It is time for sb to do sth（不定式，不用虚拟）
high time比time语气更强烈，表示'早就该...了'

examples.en: It is time we went home.
examples.cn: 我们该回家了。

examples.en: It is high time that you stopped complaining.
examples.cn: 你早该停止抱怨了。

examples.en: It is about time we left.
examples.cn: 我们差不多该走了。

examples.en: It is time for us to go.
examples.cn: 我们该走了。（不定式结构）

examples.en: It is high time that the problem were solved.
examples.cn: 这个问题早该解决了。

commonMistakes.wrong: It is time we go home.
commonMistakes.correct: It is time we went home.
commonMistakes.reason: It is time后用虚拟语气，动词用过去时went，不能用现在时go

commonMistakes.wrong: It is high time you stop complaining.
commonMistakes.correct: It is high time you stopped complaining.
commonMistakes.reason: It is high time后用虚拟语气，动词用过去时stopped

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: It is (high) time + 过去时='该做...了'。也可以用It is time for sb to do sth（更简单）。high=早就该。

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).name: 含蓄虚拟语气（without/but for等）
其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).plainLanguage: 有时候不用if也能表达虚拟语气，用without（如果没有）、but for（要不是）、otherwise（否则）等词来暗示。'要不是你的帮助，我就失败了'就是But for your help, I would have failed。主句仍然用虚拟语气。
rules: without + 名词/代词：如果没有...（主句用虚拟语气）
but for + 名词/代词：要不是...（主句用虚拟语气）
otherwise：否则（暗示与事实相反，主句用虚拟）
or / or else：否则（暗示与事实相反，主句用虚拟）
but that + 从句：若不是...（主句用虚拟）
主句虚拟形式：would/could/should/might + do（对现在）/ + have done（对过去）

examples.en: Without your help, I would have failed.
examples.cn: 没有你的帮助，我就失败了。（对过去）

examples.en: But for the rain, we would have gone out.
examples.cn: 要不是下雨，我们就出去了。

examples.en: I was busy, otherwise I would have gone to the party.
examples.cn: 我很忙，否则我就去派对了。

examples.en: Without water, there would be no life.
examples.cn: 没有水就没有生命。（对现在）

examples.en: He would have died, but that the doctor arrived in time.
examples.cn: 要不是医生及时赶到，他就死了。

commonMistakes.wrong: Without your help, I will fail.
commonMistakes.correct: Without your help, I would have failed.
commonMistakes.reason: 与过去事实相反，主句要用虚拟语气would have failed，不用will fail

commonMistakes.wrong: But for your help, I will pass the exam.
commonMistakes.correct: But for your help, I would pass the exam.
commonMistakes.reason: but for表示与事实相反的假设，主句用虚拟would pass，不用will pass

其他虚拟 (Other Subjunctive).tips: 含蓄虚拟不用if！without/but for/otherwise/or暗示虚拟，主句照常用would do（现在）/would have done（过去）。
relatedCategories: 与现在事实相反的虚拟
与过去事实相反的虚拟

倒装句 (Inversion).name: 完全倒装
倒装句 (Inversion).plainLanguage: 完全倒装就是把整个谓语提到主语前面。常用于表示方位的副词（here/there/up/down等）或介词短语放在句首时。比如'公交车来了'是Here comes the bus（不是The bus comes here）。
rules: 结构：副词/介词短语 + 谓语（全提） + 主语
常见触发词：here, there, up, down, in, out, away等方位副词
介词短语放句首也可触发完全倒装
主语必须是名词才能完全倒装（主语是代词则不倒装）
此时常用一般现在时或一般过去时

examples.en: Here comes the bus.
examples.cn: 公交车来了。

examples.en: There goes the bell.
examples.cn: 铃响了。

examples.en: Out rushed the children.
examples.cn: 孩子们冲了出来。

examples.en: In front of the house stands a tall tree.
examples.cn: 房前有一棵大树。

examples.en: Away flew the bird.
examples.cn: 鸟飞走了。

commonMistakes.wrong: Here the bus comes.
commonMistakes.correct: Here comes the bus.
commonMistakes.reason: here在句首，主语the bus是名词，需要完全倒装为Here comes the bus

commonMistakes.wrong: Here comes he.
commonMistakes.correct: Here he comes.
commonMistakes.reason: 主语是代词he时不倒装，用Here he comes

commonMistakes.wrong: Out the children rushed.
commonMistakes.correct: Out rushed the children.
commonMistakes.reason: out在句首，主语the children是名词，需要完全倒装为Out rushed the children

倒装句 (Inversion).tips: 完全倒装=谓语全提主语前。名词主语才倒装，代词主语不倒装！Here comes the bus. But: Here he comes.

倒装句 (Inversion).name: 部分倒装
倒装句 (Inversion).plainLanguage: 部分倒装就是只把助动词/情态动词/be动词提到主语前面。常见触发条件：否定词放句首（never/hardly/not only等）、only+状语放句首、so/neither/nor放句首表示'也/也不'。
rules: 否定副词放句首：Never/Hardly/Seldom/Little/Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + ...
only + 状语放句首：Only then/Only by/Only when + 助动词 + 主语 + ...
so/neither/nor放句首：So/Neither/Nor + 助动词 + 主语
Not until放句首：Not until + ... + 助动词 + 主语 + ...
No sooner...than / Hardly...when：No sooner/Hardly + had + 主语 + 过去分词

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.cn: 我从没见过这么美的地方。

examples.en: Only then did he realize his mistake.
examples.cn: 直到那时他才意识到自己的错误。

examples.en: Not only does he study hard, but he also helps others.
examples.cn: 他不仅努力学习，还帮助别人。

examples.en: Hardly had he sat down when the phone rang.
examples.cn: 他刚坐下电话就响了。

examples.en: Not until midnight did he finish his work.
examples.cn: 直到午夜他才完成工作。

commonMistakes.wrong: Never I have seen such a beautiful place.
commonMistakes.correct: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
commonMistakes.reason: 否定词Never放句首要部分倒装，把have提到主语I前面

commonMistakes.wrong: Only then he realized his mistake.
commonMistakes.correct: Only then did he realize his mistake.
commonMistakes.reason: Only + then放句首要部分倒装，用did提问的形式

commonMistakes.wrong: Not only he studies hard, but he also helps others.
commonMistakes.correct: Not only does he study hard, but he also helps others.
commonMistakes.reason: Not only放句首要部分倒装，用does + study（原形）

倒装句 (Inversion).tips: 否定词/only放句首=部分倒装！把助动词/be/情态动词提前。Not only...but also前后要平衡。

倒装句 (Inversion).name: not only...but also的倒装用法
倒装句 (Inversion).plainLanguage: 当not only放在句首时，它后面的句子要部分倒装（把助动词/be/情态动词提到主语前），但but (also)后面的句子不倒装。比如'他不仅聪明而且勤奋'是Not only is he smart, but he is also hardworking。
rules: not only放句首时，not only所在的分句部分倒装
结构：Not only + 助动词/be/情态 + 主语 + 谓语, but (also) + 主语 + 谓语
but also后面的分句不倒装（正常语序）
also可以省略，也可以放在句中或句末
前后时态和结构要保持平衡

examples.en: Not only is he smart, but he is also hardworking.
examples.cn: 他不仅聪明而且勤奋。

examples.en: Not only did he apologize, but he also paid for the damage.
examples.cn: 他不仅道了歉，还赔偿了损失。

examples.en: Not only can she speak English, but she can also speak French.
examples.cn: 她不仅会说英语，还会说法语。

examples.en: Not only was he a great writer, but he was also a great thinker.
examples.cn: 他不仅是伟大的作家，还是伟大的思想家。

examples.en: Not only have I finished the work, but I have also checked it twice.
examples.cn: 我不仅完成了工作，还检查了两遍。

commonMistakes.wrong: Not only he is smart, but he is also hardworking.
commonMistakes.correct: Not only is he smart, but he is also hardworking.
commonMistakes.reason: not only放句首时要部分倒装，is要提到主语he前面

commonMistakes.wrong: Not only is he smart, but also is he hardworking.
commonMistakes.correct: Not only is he smart, but he is also hardworking.
commonMistakes.reason: but also后面的分句不倒装，保持正常语序

倒装句 (Inversion).tips: not only在句首→前倒后不倒！Not only + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语, but 主语 also + 谓语。also可省略或移位。

强调句 (Cleft Sentence).name: 强调句的结构
强调句 (Cleft Sentence).plainLanguage: 强调句就是'就是...才...'。结构是It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他部分。可以强调主语、宾语、时间状语、地点状语等。比如'我就是昨天在公园遇到他的'用It was yesterday that I met him in the park。
rules: 结构：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 句子其他部分
强调人可用who，强调物用that
可以强调主语、宾语、状语
不能强调谓语动词（谓语用do/does/did强调）
判断方法：去掉It is/was和that后，句子仍完整=强调句
not...until的强调：It is/was not until...that...

examples.en: It was John who/that broke the window.
examples.cn: 就是约翰打破了窗户。（强调主语）

examples.en: It was the window that John broke.
examples.cn: 约翰打破的就是窗户。（强调宾语）

examples.en: It was yesterday that I met him.
examples.cn: 我就是在昨天遇到他的。（强调时间状语）

examples.en: It was in the park that I met him.
examples.cn: 我就是在公园遇到他的。（强调地点状语）

examples.en: It was not until midnight that he came back.
examples.cn: 直到午夜他才回来。

commonMistakes.wrong: It was yesterday when I met him.
commonMistakes.correct: It was yesterday that I met him.
commonMistakes.reason: 强调句用that连接，不能用when（when是定语从句/时间状语从句的引导词）

commonMistakes.wrong: It was he who broke the window, isn't it?
commonMistakes.correct: It was he who broke the window, wasn't it?
commonMistakes.reason: 反义疑问句要跟主句时态一致，It was用wasn't it

commonMistakes.wrong: It is I who am wrong.
commonMistakes.correct: It is I who am wrong.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。强调主语I时，从句谓语与I保持一致用am

强调句 (Cleft Sentence).tips: 强调句=It is/was + 强调部分 + that + 其他。去掉It is/was...that后句子仍通顺=是强调句！强调谓语用do/does/did。

省略句 (Ellipsis).name: 省略句的用法
省略句 (Ellipsis).plainLanguage: 省略句就是在不引起误解的情况下省掉一些词，使语言更简洁。常见省略：主谓省略（如'想要吗？'Want some?）、不定式省略to（如'你想去吗？''I'd love to'）、状语从句省略主语和be动词。
rules: 并列句省略：相同的主语/谓语/宾语可省略
状语从句省略：When/While/If/Though + 主语 + be可省略主语和be
不定式省略：保留to省略后面的动词
日常口语省略：Got it? = Have you got it?
答语省略：Are you ready? - Yes, I am (ready).

examples.en: While (I was) walking in the park, I met a friend.
examples.cn: 在公园散步时我遇到了朋友。

examples.en: If (it is) necessary, we will ask for help.
examples.cn: 如果有必要，我们会求助。

examples.en: - Would you like to come? - I'd love to (come).
examples.cn: ——你想来吗？——我很想来。

examples.en: She likes apples, and I (like apples) too.
examples.cn: 她喜欢苹果，我也是。

examples.en: Though (he was) tired, he kept working.
examples.cn: 虽然累了，他还是继续工作。

commonMistakes.wrong: While walking in the park, a friend was met by me.
commonMistakes.correct: While walking in the park, I met a friend.
commonMistakes.reason: 省略状语从句时，walking的逻辑主语必须和主句主语一致。应该是I在走，不是a friend被遇到

commonMistakes.wrong: If necessary, we will ask for help.
commonMistakes.correct: If necessary, we will ask for help.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。If (it is) necessary是常见的省略结构

commonMistakes.wrong: - Would you like to come? - I'd love.
commonMistakes.correct: - Would you like to come? - I'd love to.
commonMistakes.reason: 省略动词时必须保留不定式符号to，即I'd love to (come)

省略句 (Ellipsis).tips: 省略的原则：不引起歧义。状语从句省略主语+be要保证逻辑主语一致。不定式省略保留to。Got it? = 懂了吗？

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: 反义疑问句
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: 反义疑问句就是'是吧/不是吗'的提问方式。规则是'前肯后否，前否后肯'——前面肯定后面否定，前面否定后面肯定。比如'你是学生，不是吗？'是You are a student, aren't you?
rules: 前肯后否，前否后肯
疑问部分的动词和主句一致，人称代词和主句主语一致
句中有not/never/hardly/seldom等否定词时，后面用肯定
Let's...后面用shall we?；Let us...后面用will you?
祈使句后面用will you?；I think/believe + 宾语从句，疑问部分跟从句

examples.en: You are a student, aren't you?
examples.cn: 你是学生，不是吗？

examples.en: He doesn't like coffee, does he?
examples.cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，是吗？

examples.en: She has never been to Paris, has she?
examples.cn: 她从没去过巴黎，是吗？

examples.en: Let's go, shall we?
examples.cn: 我们走吧，好吗？

examples.en: I think he is right, isn't he?
examples.cn: 我认为他是对的，不是吗？（跟从句）

commonMistakes.wrong: He is a teacher, isn't he? - Yes, he is.
commonMistakes.correct: He is a teacher, isn't he? - Yes, he is.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。中文'是的'表示同意前面的陈述，英文回答Yes后接肯定，No后接否定

commonMistakes.wrong: There is a book on the desk, isn't it?
commonMistakes.correct: There is a book on the desk, isn't there?
commonMistakes.reason: there be句型的反义疑问句用isn't there/aren't there

commonMistakes.wrong: Let's go, will you?
commonMistakes.correct: Let's go, shall we?
commonMistakes.reason: Let's包含说话人和听话人，用shall we；Let us（不含听话人）用will you

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: 前肯后否，前否后肯。Let's用shall we，Let us/祈使用will you。I think后的反义疑问跟从句主语。

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: 感叹句
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: 感叹句就是表达强烈感情的句子。有两种形式：What + 名词短语！和How + 形容词/副词！比如'多美的花啊'是What beautiful flowers they are！'多快啊'是How fast he runs！
rules: What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + (主语 + 谓语)!
How + 形容词/副词 + (主语 + 谓语)!
What修饰名词，How修饰形容词或副词
What a/an + 单数可数名词；What + 不可数/复数名词（不加a/an）
感叹句末尾用感叹号，主语和谓语可以省略

examples.en: What a beautiful day it is!
examples.cn: 多美的一天啊！

examples.en: What beautiful flowers they are!
examples.cn: 多美的花啊！

examples.en: What bad weather it is!
examples.cn: 多糟糕的天气啊！

examples.en: How fast he runs!
examples.cn: 他跑得多快啊！

examples.en: How clever the girl is!
examples.cn: 那女孩多聪明啊！

commonMistakes.wrong: How a beautiful day it is!
commonMistakes.correct: What a beautiful day it is!
commonMistakes.reason: 后面有名词day，应该用What修饰，不能用How

commonMistakes.wrong: What fast he runs!
commonMistakes.correct: How fast he runs!
commonMistakes.reason: fast是副词，应该用How修饰，不能用What

commonMistakes.wrong: What a bad weather it is!
commonMistakes.correct: What bad weather it is!
commonMistakes.reason: weather是不可数名词，不能用a，直接What bad weather

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: 有名词用What，有形容词/副词无名词用How。不可数名词和复数名词不加a/an。What a + 单数可数名词！

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: so/neither倒装句
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: so + 助动词 + 主语表示'也'（用于肯定句），neither/nor + 助动词 + 主语表示'也不'（用于否定句）。比如'我也是'是So am I，'我也不'是Neither do I。
rules: So + 助动词/be/情态动词 + 主语：表示'...也这样'（肯定）
Neither/Nor + 助动词/be/情态动词 + 主语：表示'...也不这样'（否定）
助动词要与前面的句子保持时态一致
so it is/was with sb：用于混合情况（前面有不同类型的动词）
So + 主语 + 助动词：表示'确实如此'（不倒装，表赞同）

examples.en: He likes English. - So do I.
examples.cn: 他喜欢英语。——我也是。

examples.en: She can swim. - So can her brother.
examples.cn: 她会游泳。——她弟弟也会。

examples.en: He doesn't like coffee. - Neither do I.
examples.cn: 他不喜欢咖啡。——我也不喜欢。

examples.en: He is a teacher. - So am I.
examples.cn: 他是老师。——我也是。

examples.en: He likes English, and so do I.
examples.cn: 他喜欢英语，我也是。

commonMistakes.wrong: He likes English. - So I do.
commonMistakes.correct: He likes English. - So do I.
commonMistakes.reason: 表示'也'要用倒装So do I（助动词+主语）；So I do表示'我确实如此'，意思不同

commonMistakes.wrong: He doesn't like coffee. - So don't I.
commonMistakes.correct: He doesn't like coffee. - Neither do I.
commonMistakes.reason: 否定句的'也不'用Neither/Nor，不能用So don't

commonMistakes.wrong: He likes English and so likes I.
commonMistakes.correct: He likes English, and so do I.
commonMistakes.reason: so后要用助动词do + 主语I，不能用动词likes直接接I

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: 肯定用So+助动词+主语，否定用Neither/Nor+助动词+主语。So do I=我也这样；So I do=我确实如此（不倒装）。

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: not...until句型
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: not...until表示'直到...才'。比如'直到雨停了我才走'是I didn't leave until the rain stopped。肯定句用until表示'做到...为止'，否定句用not...until表示'直到...才'。
rules: not...until：直到...才（主句否定，until接时间点/从句）
肯定句：do...until：做到...为止（I worked until midnight.）
强调句式：It is/was not until...that...（直到...才）
倒装句式：Not until... + 助动词 + 主语 + 谓语（部分倒装）
until接时间点，till与其用法相同但更口语化

examples.en: I didn't go to bed until I finished my homework.
examples.cn: 直到做完作业我才去睡觉。

examples.en: He didn't leave until the rain stopped.
examples.cn: 直到雨停了他才离开。

examples.en: It was not until yesterday that I knew the truth.
examples.cn: 直到昨天我才知道真相。（强调句）

examples.en: Not until the rain stopped did he leave.
examples.cn: 直到雨停他才离开。（倒装）

examples.en: She worked until midnight.
examples.cn: 她工作到午夜。（肯定句=做到...为止）

commonMistakes.wrong: I didn't go to bed until I will finish my homework.
commonMistakes.correct: I didn't go to bed until I finish my homework.
commonMistakes.reason: until引导的时间状语从句中用一般现在时表将来，不用will finish

commonMistakes.wrong: Not until the rain stopped he left.
commonMistakes.correct: Not until the rain stopped did he leave.
commonMistakes.reason: Not until放句首时要部分倒装，用did he leave而不是he left

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: not...until='直到...才'。三种变体：①普通否定 ②It was not until...that...（强调） ③Not until...did...（倒装）。注意主将从现！

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: too...to与enough to句型
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: too...to表示'太...以至于不能'，自带否定意味。比如'他太累了走不动'是He is too tired to walk。enough to表示'足够...可以'，是肯定。比如'他够大了可以上学'是He is old enough to go to school。
rules: too + adj/adv + to do：太...以至于不能
adj/adv + enough + to do：足够...可以（enough放在形容词/副词后面）
enough + n + to do：有足够的...可以
too...to可转换为so...that...can't
enough to可转换为so...that...can
too...to中的to是真正的不定式，不是介词

examples.en: He is too tired to walk.
examples.cn: 他太累了走不动。（= He is so tired that he cannot walk.）

examples.en: She is old enough to go to school.
examples.cn: 她够大了可以上学。

examples.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
examples.cn: 箱子太重了我搬不动。

examples.en: I have enough money to buy a car.
examples.cn: 我有足够的钱买车。

examples.en: This problem is too difficult for me to solve.
examples.cn: 这问题对我来说太难了，解决不了。

commonMistakes.wrong: He is too tired to walking.
commonMistakes.correct: He is too tired to walk.
commonMistakes.reason: too...to中的to是不定式符号，后接动词原形walk，不是walking

commonMistakes.wrong: He is enough old to go to school.
commonMistakes.correct: He is old enough to go to school.
commonMistakes.reason: enough修饰形容词时要放在形容词后面，old enough而不是enough old

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: too...to=太...不能（自带否定）。enough to=足够...可以。enough在形容词后（old enough），在名词前（enough money）。两者可互换为so...that句型。

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).name: the more...the more句型
其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).plainLanguage: the more...the more...表示'越...越...'。比如'越多越好'是The more, the better。'你越努力成绩越好'是The harder you work, the better your grades will be。前半句是条件，后半句是结果，两个the都是副词。
rules: 结构：The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...（越...越...）
前半句是条件，后半句是结果
两个the都是副词，修饰比较级
可以省略主语和谓语：The more, the better.（越多越好）
也可带主谓：The harder you work, the more you will earn.
the + 比较级可修饰形容词、副词或名词

examples.en: The more, the better.
examples.cn: 越多越好。

examples.en: The harder you work, the better results you will get.
examples.cn: 你越努力，成绩越好。

examples.en: The more you read, the more you know.
examples.cn: 你读得越多，知道得越多。

examples.en: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
examples.cn: 你越早开始，就越早完成。

examples.en: The busier he is, the happier he feels.
examples.cn: 他越忙越开心。

commonMistakes.wrong: More you read, more you know.
commonMistakes.correct: The more you read, the more you know.
commonMistakes.reason: the more...the more句型中两个比较级前都要有the

commonMistakes.wrong: The hard you work, the good results you get.
commonMistakes.correct: The harder you work, the better results you get.
commonMistakes.reason: 要用比较级harder和better，不能用原级hard和good

其他特殊句式 (Other Special Structures).tips: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... = 越...越...。记住：两个比较级前都有the，且都用比较级！前后可省主谓。

名词 (Noun).name: 可数与不可数名词
名词 (Noun).plainLanguage: 可数名词就是可以数的名词，有单数和复数形式，比如apples/books。不可数名词就是不能数的名词，没有复数形式，比如water/money/information。不可数名词要表示数量需要用a piece of / a glass of等量词。
rules: 可数名词：有单数和复数形式，可用a/an修饰
不可数名词：只有单数形式，不能用a/an修饰
不可数名词表数量：a piece of / a glass of / a cup of + 不可数名词
some/any/few/little：可数用few/a few，不可数用little/a little
many + 可数复数；much + 不可数

examples.en: I have two books and three pens.
examples.cn: 我有两本书和三支笔。

examples.en: There is some water in the glass.
examples.cn: 杯子里有一些水。

examples.en: I need a piece of paper.
examples.cn: 我需要一张纸。

examples.en: She has much money.
examples.cn: 她有很多钱。

examples.en: There are a few apples in the basket.
examples.cn: 篮子里有几个苹果。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have two waters.
commonMistakes.correct: I have two glasses of water.
commonMistakes.reason: water是不可数名词，不能直接加s，要用量词two glasses of water

commonMistakes.wrong: I need a paper.
commonMistakes.correct: I need a piece of paper.
commonMistakes.reason: 当paper表示'纸'时是不可数的，要用a piece of paper；a paper表示'一份报纸/论文'是可数的

commonMistakes.wrong: She has many money.
commonMistakes.correct: She has much money.
commonMistakes.reason: money是不可数名词，用much不用many

名词 (Noun).tips: 可数加s用many/few，不可数不加s用much/little。不可数表数量要用量词（a piece of / a cup of）。常见不可数：water/money/milk/information/advice/furniture。

名词 (Noun).name: 名词复数变化规则
名词 (Noun).plainLanguage: 可数名词变复数有规则变化和不规则变化两种。规则变化一般加s，以s/x/sh/ch/o结尾加es，辅音+y结尾把y变i加es，f/fe结尾变ves。不规则变化需要单独记。
rules: 一般加s：book→books, student→students
以s/x/sh/ch/o结尾加es：box→boxes, watch→watches, hero→heroes, tomato→tomatoes
辅音+y结尾变y为i加es：city→cities, baby→babies
f/fe结尾变ves：leaf→leaves, knife→knives, wolf→wolves
不规则：man→men, woman→women, child→children, foot→feet, tooth→teeth, mouse→mice, sheep→sheep（不变）

examples.en: There are many books on the shelf.
examples.cn: 书架上有许多书。

examples.en: I can see three boxes over there.
examples.cn: 我能看到那边有三个箱子。

examples.en: The cities are very crowded.
examples.cn: 这些城市很拥挤。

examples.en: He collected some leaves in autumn.
examples.cn: 他在秋天收集了一些树叶。

examples.en: Three children are playing in the park.
examples.cn: 三个孩子在公园玩。

commonMistakes.wrong: I can see three boxs.
commonMistakes.correct: I can see three boxes.
commonMistakes.reason: 以x结尾的名词复数要加es，不是直接加s

commonMistakes.wrong: There are many sheeps.
commonMistakes.correct: There are many sheep.
commonMistakes.reason: sheep是不规则变化，单复数同形，不加s

commonMistakes.wrong: The citys are very crowded.
commonMistakes.correct: The cities are very crowded.
commonMistakes.reason: 辅音字母+y结尾，y要变i再加es

名词 (Noun).tips: s/x/sh/ch/o加es，y变i加es，f/fe变ves。不规则：man-men, child-children, foot-feet, tooth-teeth, sheep-sheep。photo和piano特殊（只加s）。

名词 (Noun).name: 名词所有格
名词 (Noun).plainLanguage: 名词所有格表示'某人的/某物的'。有生命的名词加's（Tom's book），复数名词以s结尾的只加'（the students' room）。无生命的名词用of结构（the door of the room）。
rules: 有生命名词单数 + 's：Tom's book, the dog's tail
有生命名词复数以s结尾 + '：the students' room, the teachers' office
有生命名词复数不以s结尾 + 's：children's toys, men's clothes
无生命名词用of：the leg of the table, the title of the book
表示时间/距离/价值等也可用's：today's news, a week's holiday

examples.en: This is Tom's book.
examples.cn: 这是汤姆的书。

examples.en: The students' room is clean.
examples.cn: 学生们的房间很干净。

examples.en: These are children's toys.
examples.cn: 这些是孩子们的玩具。

examples.en: The leg of the table is broken.
examples.cn: 桌腿坏了。

examples.en: It's today's news.
examples.cn: 这是今天的新闻。

commonMistakes.wrong: These are Tom's and Jerry books.
commonMistakes.correct: These are Tom and Jerry's books.
commonMistakes.reason: 两人共有的东西，所有格只加在最后一个名词后：Tom and Jerry's（共有的书）

commonMistakes.wrong: The leg's table is broken.
commonMistakes.correct: The leg of the table is broken.
commonMistakes.reason: 无生命名词不用's所有格，用of结构

commonMistakes.wrong: The students's room is clean.
commonMistakes.correct: The students' room is clean.
commonMistakes.reason: 复数名词以s结尾，只加'不加's

名词 (Noun).tips: 有生命加's（复数s结尾只加'），无生命用of。两人共有的只加最后一个名词后面。时间距离也可用's。

代词 (Pronoun).name: 人称代词与物主代词
代词 (Pronoun).plainLanguage: 人称代词就是'我你他她它我们你们他们'（I/you/he/she/it/we/they），分主格（作主语）和宾格（作宾语）。物主代词表示'某人的'，分形容词性（my/your等，后面接名词）和名词性（mine/yours等，后面不接名词）。
rules: 主格：I, you, he, she, it, we, they（作主语）
宾格：me, you, him, her, it, us, them（作宾语）
形容词性物主代词：my, your, his, her, its, our, their（后面接名词）
名词性物主代词：mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs（后面不接名词）
主格作主语，宾格作宾语/介词宾语

examples.en: I love her.
examples.cn: 我爱她。（I主格，her宾格）

examples.en: This is my book.
examples.cn: 这是我的书。（my+book）

examples.en: This book is mine.
examples.cn: 这本书是我的。（mine后面不加名词）

examples.en: He gave it to me.
examples.cn: 他把它给了我。（me作介词宾语）

examples.en: Our school is bigger than theirs.
examples.cn: 我们学校比他们的大。（our+school，theirs=their school）

commonMistakes.wrong: Me and him are friends.
commonMistakes.correct: He and I are friends.
commonMistakes.reason: 作主语要用主格He and I，不能用宾格me and him

commonMistakes.wrong: This is my. / This is mine book.
commonMistakes.correct: This is mine. / This is my book.
commonMistakes.reason: 名词性物主代词mine后面不接名词；形容词性物主代词my后面必须接名词

commonMistakes.wrong: Her is my friend.
commonMistakes.correct: She is my friend.
commonMistakes.reason: 作主语要用主格She，不能用宾格her

代词 (Pronoun).tips: 主格做主语，宾格做宾语。my/your后接名词，mine/yours后不接名词。记住'我的书'=my book='the book is mine'。

代词 (Pronoun).name: 反身代词
代词 (Pronoun).plainLanguage: 反身代词就是'我自己/你自己/他自己'等（myself/yourself/himself等），表示动作回到主语自己身上。比如'我伤了我自己'是I hurt myself。也用于强调'亲自'。
rules: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
表示动作回到主语自己：I hurt myself.
强调'亲自'：I myself did it. / I did it myself.
by oneself = alone（独自）：I did it by myself.
常见搭配：enjoy oneself（玩得开心）, help oneself to（自取）, teach oneself（自学）

examples.en: I hurt myself while playing.
examples.cn: 我玩的时候伤到了自己。

examples.en: She taught herself English.
examples.cn: 她自学英语。

examples.en: Help yourselves to some food.
examples.cn: 你们自己拿些吃的。

examples.en: I can do it by myself.
examples.cn: 我能自己做。

examples.en: Did you enjoy yourselves at the party?
examples.cn: 你们在派对上玩得开心吗？

commonMistakes.wrong: He hurt hisself.
commonMistakes.correct: He hurt himself.
commonMistakes.reason: he的反身代词是himself，不是hisself

commonMistakes.wrong: We enjoyed ourself at the party.
commonMistakes.correct: We enjoyed ourselves at the party.
commonMistakes.reason: we的反身代词是ourselves（复数），不是ourself

commonMistakes.wrong: The girl is too young to dress herselves.
commonMistakes.correct: The girl is too young to dress herself.
commonMistakes.reason: the girl是单数第三人称，反身代词用herself

代词 (Pronoun).tips: 反身代词=形容词性物主代词+self/selves。I→myself, he→himself, they→themselves。常见搭配：enjoy oneself/help oneself to/teach oneself/by oneself。

代词 (Pronoun).name: 不定代词
代词 (Pronoun).plainLanguage: 不定代词就是不指明特定的人或物的代词，如some/any/every/no系列。some用于肯定句，any用于否定和疑问句。every/each/all都表示'每个'但用法不同。不定代词作主语时谓语用单数。
rules: some/someone/something：用于肯定句（疑问句中表请求/邀请也可用some）
any/anyone/anything：用于否定句和疑问句
every + 单数名词，强调整体；each + 单数名词，强调个体
no one/nobody/nothing：表示'没有人/没有东西'
复合不定代词（someone/anything等）作主语时谓语用单数
修饰复合不定代词的形容词要后置：something important

examples.en: There is something wrong with my phone.
examples.cn: 我的手机出了点问题。

examples.en: Is there anything I can do for you?
examples.cn: 我能为你做些什么吗？

examples.en: Nobody is perfect.
examples.cn: 没有人是完美的。

examples.en: I have something important to tell you.
examples.cn: 我有重要的事要告诉你。

examples.en: Everyone is here.
examples.cn: 大家都到了。

commonMistakes.wrong: Is there something I can do for you?
commonMistakes.correct: Is there anything I can do for you?
commonMistakes.reason: 疑问句通常用anything，不用something（除非表请求/邀请）

commonMistakes.wrong: Everyone are here.
commonMistakes.correct: Everyone is here.
commonMistakes.reason: 复合不定代词everyone作主语，谓语动词用单数is

commonMistakes.wrong: I have important something to tell you.
commonMistakes.correct: I have something important to tell you.
commonMistakes.reason: 修饰复合不定代词的形容词要后置，放在something后面

代词 (Pronoun).tips: some用于肯定，any用于否定/疑问。不定代词做主语=单数！形容词修饰不定代词要放后面：something important不是important something。

代词 (Pronoun).name: 不定代词的修饰语位置
代词 (Pronoun).plainLanguage: 修饰不定代词（something/anything/nothing/everything等）的形容词要放在后面，不是前面。比如'重要的事'是something important，不是important something。还有else也放在不定代词后面，如'别的什么'是something else。
rules: 形容词修饰不定代词时必须后置：something important, nothing wrong, anything new
else修饰不定代词/疑问代词时后置：something else, anyone else, what else
不定式修饰不定代词也后置：something to eat, nothing to do
否定句中用anything代替something：I don't have anything to say.
修饰不定代词的形容词可带自己的状语：something very important

examples.en: I have something important to tell you.
examples.cn: 我有重要的事要告诉你。

examples.en: Is there anything wrong with the car?
examples.cn: 车子有什么问题吗？

examples.en: There is nothing else I can do.
examples.cn: 我没有别的办法了。

examples.en: I don't have anything to eat.
examples.cn: 我没有东西吃了。

examples.en: We need someone else to help us.
examples.cn: 我们需要别的人来帮忙。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have important something to tell you.
commonMistakes.correct: I have something important to tell you.
commonMistakes.reason: 形容词修饰不定代词something时要后置，不能放在前面

commonMistakes.wrong: I don't have something to eat.
commonMistakes.correct: I don't have anything to eat.
commonMistakes.reason: 否定句中要用anything，不用something

commonMistakes.wrong: Do you have else anything?
commonMistakes.correct: Do you have anything else?
commonMistakes.reason: else修饰不定代词时要后置，放在anything后面

代词 (Pronoun).tips: 不定代词+形容词=后置（something important）！不定代词+else=后置（anything else）！否定句用anything不用something。

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).name: 比较级和最高级
形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).plainLanguage: 比较级表示'更...'（taller=更高），最高级表示'最...'（tallest=最高）。规则变化加er/est，长的词用more/most。不规则变化需单独记（good→better→best）。
rules: 单音节/部分双音节词：+er / +est（tall→taller→tallest）
以e结尾：+r / +st（large→larger→largest）
辅音+y结尾：变y为i+er/est（happy→happier→happiest）
重读闭音节：双写末尾辅音+er/est（big→bigger→biggest）
多音节词：more/most + 原级（beautiful→more beautiful→most beautiful）
不规则：good/well→better→best, bad/ill→worse→worst, many/much→more→most, little→less→least, far→farther/further→farthest/furthest

examples.en: Tom is taller than Mike.
examples.cn: 汤姆比迈克高。

examples.en: She is the most beautiful girl in our class.
examples.cn: 她是我们班最漂亮的女孩。

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.cn: 这本书比那本有趣。

examples.en: He is the best student in the class.
examples.cn: 他是班里最好的学生。

examples.en: My room is bigger than yours.
examples.cn: 我的房间比你的大。

commonMistakes.wrong: He is more tall than me.
commonMistakes.correct: He is taller than me.
commonMistakes.reason: tall是单音节词，比较级加er，不用more

commonMistakes.wrong: She is the most beautiful in our class.
commonMistakes.correct: She is the most beautiful girl in our class.
commonMistakes.reason: 最高级后面要加名词或用the most beautiful one，不能只用the most beautiful

commonMistakes.wrong: He is gooder than me.
commonMistakes.correct: He is better than me.
commonMistakes.reason: good的比较级是不规则变化better，不是gooder

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).tips: 短词加er/est，长词用more/most。不规则必背：good-better-best, bad-worse-worst, many/much-more-most, little-less-least, far-farther-furthest。

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).name: 形容词与副词的区别
形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).plainLanguage: 形容词修饰名词（放在名词前或be动词后），描述'什么样的'。副词修饰动词、形容词或其他副词，描述'怎么做的/多...'。很多副词是形容词+ly（quick→quickly），但也有不改的（good→well）。
rules: 形容词：修饰名词，作定语或表语
副词：修饰动词、形容词、副词，作状语
形容词+ly→副词（quick→quickly, careful→carefully）
例外：good（形容词）→well（副词），fast既是形容词也是副词
感官动词后用形容词：look/sound/smell/taste/feel + 形容词

examples.en: She is a careful driver.

examples.en: The food tastes good.
examples.cn: 这食物味道好。（taste后用形容词good）

examples.en: He runs fast.

examples.en: The song sounds beautiful.

commonMistakes.correct: She drives carefully.

commonMistakes.wrong: The food tastes well.
commonMistakes.correct: The food tastes good.
commonMistakes.reason: taste是感官动词，后面用形容词good，不用副词well

commonMistakes.wrong: He is a good singer and sings good.
commonMistakes.correct: He is a good singer and sings well.
commonMistakes.reason: 修饰动词sings用副词well，不用形容词good

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).tips: 形容词修饰名词（a careful driver），副词修饰动词（drives carefully）。good是形容词，well是副词。感官动词（look/sound/taste/smell/feel）后用形容词！

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).name: 副词的位置规则
形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).plainLanguage: 副词放在哪里有讲究。频度副词（always/often/never等）放在实义动词前、be动词后；方式副词（quickly/carefully）放在动词或宾语后；程度副词（very/quite）放在形容词或副词前。位置不对意思可能就变了。
rules: 频度副词（always/usually/often/sometimes/never）：放在实义动词前，be动词/助动词/情态动词后
频度副词在多个助动词时放在第一个助动词后：I have always been careful.
方式副词（quickly/carefully/well）：放在动词后或宾语后（不能放在动词和宾语之间）
程度副词（very/quite/rather/pretty）：放在形容词或副词前
时间/地点副词：通常放在句末，强调时可放句首
enough特殊：放在形容词/副词后（good enough）

examples.en: He always gets up early.
examples.cn: 他总是早起。（always在实义动词前）

examples.en: She is always happy.
examples.cn: 她总是很开心。（always在be动词后）

examples.en: He drives carefully.
examples.cn: 他开车很小心。（carefully在动词后）

examples.en: She speaks English very well.
examples.cn: 她英语说得很好。（well在宾语后，very修饰well）

examples.en: I have never been to Paris.
examples.cn: 我从没去过巴黎。（never在have后）

commonMistakes.wrong: He gets always up early.
commonMistakes.correct: He always gets up early.
commonMistakes.reason: 频度副词always应放在实义动词gets前面，不能插在gets和up中间

commonMistakes.wrong: He carefully drives.
commonMistakes.correct: He drives carefully.
commonMistakes.reason: 方式副词carefully应放在动词后面，不能放在动词前面（除非强调）

commonMistakes.wrong: She always is happy.
commonMistakes.correct: She is always happy.
commonMistakes.reason: 频度副词always应放在be动词is后面，不能放在is前面

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).tips: 频度副词：实义动词前，be/助/情态后。方式副词：动词/宾语后。程度副词：形容词/副词前。enough：形容词后。

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).name: 常见易混淆形容词
形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).plainLanguage: 有些形容词长得像但意思大不同。alone是'独自一人'（客观状态），lonely是'孤独'（主观感受）；interesting是'令人感兴趣的'（修饰物），interested是'感兴趣的'（修饰人）。记住这些区别，用词才准确。
rules: alone（独自，客观状态）vs lonely（孤独，主观感受）
alive（活着的，多作表语）vs living（活的，可作定语）vs live（活的，修饰物，如live fish）
asleep（睡着的，表语）vs sleeping（正在睡的，定语）vs sleepy（困倦的）
-ing结尾形容词修饰物（令人...的）：interesting, exciting, boring
-ed结尾形容词修饰人（感到...的）：interested, excited, bored
dead（死的）vs deadly（致命的）vs death（死亡，名词）

examples.en: He lives alone, but he doesn't feel lonely.
examples.cn: 他独自居住，但不觉得孤独。

examples.en: The movie is interesting. I am interested in it.
examples.cn: 电影很有趣。我对它感兴趣。

examples.en: The baby is asleep. Don't wake the sleeping baby.
examples.cn: 婴儿睡着了。别叫醒正在睡觉的婴儿。

examples.en: The news is exciting. We are all excited.
examples.cn: 这消息令人兴奋。我们都感到兴奋。

examples.en: Is that fish still alive? - Yes, it's a live fish.
examples.cn: 那条鱼还活着吗？——是的，是条活鱼。

commonMistakes.wrong: He is lonely living in the house.
commonMistakes.correct: He is alone living in the house.
commonMistakes.reason: 表示客观独自一人用alone，lonely表示主观孤独感

commonMistakes.wrong: I am interesting in the book.
commonMistakes.correct: I am interested in the book.
commonMistakes.reason: 人感到感兴趣用interested，interesting修饰物（令人感兴趣的）

commonMistakes.wrong: The baby is sleeping. It is a asleep baby.
commonMistakes.correct: The baby is asleep. It is a sleeping baby.
commonMistakes.reason: asleep只能作表语不能作定语，作定语用sleeping

形容词与副词 (Adjective & Adverb).tips: alone=独自（客观），lonely=孤独（主观）。-ing修饰物（令人...的），-ed修饰人（感到...的）。asleep作表语，sleeping作定语。

冠词 (Article).name: 不定冠词a/an
冠词 (Article).plainLanguage: a和an表示'一个'，用在单数可数名词前面。a用在辅音音素开头的词前（a book, a university），an用在元音音素开头的词前（an apple, an hour）。关键看发音不是看字母！
rules: a + 辅音音素开头的词：a book, a car, a university（u发/ju:/）
an + 元音音素开头的词：an apple, an egg, an hour（h不发音）
a/an用在单数可数名词前，表'一个'或泛指
第一次提到某物用a/an
固定搭配：have a look, in a hurry, a lot of

examples.en: I have a book.
examples.cn: 我有一本书。

examples.en: She is an English teacher.
examples.cn: 她是一位英语老师。

examples.en: He waited for an hour.
examples.cn: 他等了一个小时。

examples.en: It is a university student.
examples.cn: 那是个大学生。

examples.en: There is an apple on the table.
examples.cn: 桌上有个苹果。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have an book.
commonMistakes.correct: I have a book.
commonMistakes.reason: book以辅音音素开头，用a不用an

commonMistakes.wrong: He waited for a hour.
commonMistakes.correct: He waited for an hour.
commonMistakes.reason: hour的h不发音，以元音音素开头，用an

commonMistakes.wrong: She is a honest girl.
commonMistakes.correct: She is an honest girl.
commonMistakes.reason: honest的h不发音，以元音音素开头，用an

冠词 (Article).tips: a/an看发音不看字母！元音音素用an（apple/hour/honest），辅音音素用a（book/university/useful）。h开头的词看h是否发音。

冠词 (Article).name: 定冠词the
冠词 (Article).plainLanguage: the表示'这个/那个/这些/那些'，用于特指。常见用法：再次提到的事物、双方都知道的、世上独一无二的（the sun）、乐器前（play the piano）、序数词/最高级前。
rules: 特指：再次提到或双方都知道的（the book we read yesterday）
独一无二的事物：the sun, the moon, the sky
乐器名称前：play the piano, play the guitar
序数词/最高级前：the first, the best
the + 形容词表示一类人：the rich, the poor, the blind
某些专有名词：the United States, the Pacific Ocean

examples.en: I have a book. The book is interesting.
examples.cn: 我有本书。那本书很有趣。（再次提到用the）

examples.en: The sun rises in the east.

examples.en: She plays the piano well.

examples.en: The rich should help the poor.
examples.cn: 富人应该帮助穷人。

commonMistakes.wrong: I have a book. A book is interesting.
commonMistakes.correct: I have a book. The book is interesting.
commonMistakes.reason: 第二次提到用定冠词the，表示特指那本书

commonMistakes.wrong: She plays piano well.
commonMistakes.correct: She plays the piano well.
commonMistakes.reason: 乐器名称前要加the：play the piano

commonMistakes.wrong: He is best student in our class.
commonMistakes.correct: He is the best student in our class.
commonMistakes.reason: 最高级前要加the：the best student

冠词 (Article).tips: the=特指/独一无二/乐器/最高级/序数词。the+形容词=一类人（the rich=富人）。第一次提到用a/an，再次提到用the。

冠词 (Article).name: 零冠词（不用冠词的情况）
冠词 (Article).plainLanguage: 有些情况下不用任何冠词，这叫零冠词。比如：泛指复数名词/不可数名词、三餐/球类运动/学科名前、专有名词前、节假日/月份/星期前。
rules: 泛指复数名词/不可数名词：Books are my friends. Water is important.
三餐前：have breakfast/lunch/dinner
球类运动/棋类前：play basketball, play chess
学科/语言前：study English, learn math
节假日/月份/星期前：on Monday, in January, at Christmas
称呼/头衔/独一个人头衔前：President Lincoln, Mom

冠词 (Article).tips: 零冠词=泛指复数/不可数、三餐、球类、学科、节假日、月份星期。乐器用the，球类不用the！play the piano vs play basketball。

介词 (Preposition).name: 时间介词in/on/at
介词 (Preposition).plainLanguage: in用于较大的时间（年/月/季节/上午下午）、on用于具体的某天或某天的某时段、at用于具体的时间点。口诀：大用in，小用at，具体某天用on。
rules: in + 较大时间段：in 2024, in May, in spring, in the morning
on + 具体某天/某天某时段：on Monday, on May 1st, on Sunday morning
at + 具体时间点：at 8 o'clock, at noon, at night, at midnight
in + 时间段 = ...之后：in two days（两天后）
固定搭配：in time（及时）, on time（准时）, at the same time（同时）

examples.cn: 冬天很冷。

commonMistakes.correct: I was born in 2000.

commonMistakes.wrong: The class starts in 8 o'clock.

介词 (Preposition).tips: 大用in（年/月/季节），小用at（几点几分），具体某天用on。特殊：at night, in the morning, on Sunday morning。

介词 (Preposition).name: 地点介词in/on/at
介词 (Preposition).plainLanguage: 地点也用in/on/at，但含义不同：in表示在...里面（大地方如城市国家），on表示在...上面（接触表面），at表示在某个点（具体的地址或小地点）。
rules: in + 大地方/空间内：in China, in Beijing, in the room, in the box
on + 表面上：on the table, on the wall, on the floor
at + 具体的点/地址：at the bus stop, at school, at home, at 123 Main Street
above/over：在...上方（不接触）；below/under：在...下方
between/among：between两者之间，among三者或以上之间

介词 (Preposition).tips: 大地方用in（城市/国家/房间），表面上用on，具体地点用at（车站/学校/家）。in the room, on the desk, at school。

连词 (Conjunction).name: 并列连词与从属连词
连词 (Conjunction).plainLanguage: 连词分两种：并列连词连接平等的词/短语/句子（and/but/or/so等），从属连词引导从句（because/if/when/although等）。选择哪个连词取决于两句话之间的关系。
rules: 并列连词：and（和）, but（但是）, or（或者）, so（所以）, for（因为）, yet（然而）
关联连词：both...and, either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also
从属连词：because, since, as（原因）；when, while, before, after, until, since（时间）；if, unless（条件）；although, though（让步）
because和so不能同时用，although和but不能同时用
either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also遵循就近原则

连词 (Conjunction).tips: 并列连词=and/but/or/so/for/yet。从属连词=because/when/if/although。中文'因为...所以...'/'虽然...但是...'英语只用一个连词！

数词 (Numeral).name: 数词的表达（分数/小数/倍数）
数词 (Numeral).plainLanguage: 英语数词除了基本的one/two/three，还有分数、小数、倍数等。分数用'分子基数词+分母序数词'，如1/3是one third，2/3是two thirds（分子大于1分母加s）。倍数用times，如三倍是three times。'A是B的三倍大'有三种说法。
rules: 分数：分子用基数词，分母用序数词；分子大于1时分母加s（1/3 = one third, 2/3 = two thirds）
特殊分数：1/2 = one half, 1/4 = one quarter/a quarter
小数：小数点读point（0.5 = zero point five, 2.35 = two point three five）
倍数：once=一倍/一次, twice=两倍, three times=三倍
倍数表达法①：倍数 + as + adj/adv + as（A is three times as big as B）
倍数表达法②：倍数 + 比较级 + than（A is three times bigger than B）
倍数表达法③：倍数 + the + n + of（A is three times the size of B）
百分数：数字 + percent（50% = fifty percent）

examples.en: This room is three times as large as that one.

examples.en: 0.5 can be read as zero point five.
examples.cn: 0.5读作zero point five。

examples.en: The price is twice what it was.
examples.cn: 价格是原来的两倍。

examples.en: About 50 percent of the earth's surface is water.
examples.cn: 地球表面约百分之五十是水。

commonMistakes.wrong: Two third of the students are girls.
commonMistakes.correct: Two thirds of the students are girls.
commonMistakes.reason: 分子2大于1，分母third要加s变成thirds

commonMistakes.wrong: This room is three time as large as that one.
commonMistakes.correct: This room is three times as large as that one.
commonMistakes.reason: 三倍是three times，times要加s

数词 (Numeral).tips: 分数：分子基数+分母序数，分子大于1分母加s（two thirds）。倍数三说法：as...as / 比较级than / the+n+of。小数点读point。

动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).name: make与do的搭配
动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).plainLanguage: make和do都有'做'的意思，但搭配不同。make通常指'制造/创造'某物（make a cake/a plan/a mistake），do指'执行/完成'某个活动（do homework/housework/sports）。
rules: make：制造/创造 → make a cake, make a plan, make money, make a mistake, make a decision
do：执行/完成 → do homework, do housework, do sports, do one's best, do business
make the bed（铺床）, make friends（交朋友）
do the dishes（洗碗）, do one's hair（做头发）
固定区分：make progress（进步），make a difference（有影响）

examples.en: She made a delicious cake.

examples.en: I need to do my homework.

examples.cn: 他去年赚了很多钱。

examples.en: We should do our best.
examples.cn: 我们应该尽力。

examples.en: She made a mistake in the exam.
examples.cn: 她在考试中犯了个错误。

commonMistakes.wrong: I need to make my homework.
commonMistakes.correct: I need to do my homework.
commonMistakes.reason: homework用do搭配：do homework，不用make

commonMistakes.wrong: She did a delicious cake.
commonMistakes.correct: She made a delicious cake.
commonMistakes.reason: 做蛋糕是制造/创造，用make a cake

commonMistakes.wrong: He made a lot of progress.
commonMistakes.correct: He made a lot of progress.
commonMistakes.reason: 此句正确。make progress是固定搭配，用make

动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).tips: make=制造创造（蛋糕/计划/钱/错误/决定/进步）；do=执行完成（作业/家务/运动/尽力/生意）。记住固定搭配是最快的方法！

动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).name: take与get的搭配
动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).plainLanguage: take和get有很多固定搭配。take表示'拿走/花费/接受'（take a bus/take medicine/take time），get表示'得到/变得/到达'（get a letter/get angry/get to school）。
rules: take：take a bus（坐公交）, take medicine（吃药）, take time（花时间）, take a photo（拍照）, take an exam（参加考试）
get：get a letter（收到信）, get angry（变生气）, get to school（到学校）, get up（起床）, get ready（准备好）
take it easy（别紧张）, take care of（照顾）
get along with（相处）, get rid of（摆脱）
take place（发生/举行）, take part in（参加）

examples.en: I take the bus to school every day.

examples.en: He got a letter from his friend.
examples.cn: 他收到了朋友的信。

commonMistakes.wrong: I get the bus to school.
commonMistakes.correct: I take the bus to school.
commonMistakes.reason: 坐公交用take a bus，不用get

commonMistakes.wrong: It gets me an hour to get there.
commonMistakes.correct: It takes me an hour to get there.
commonMistakes.reason: 花费时间用It takes sb...，不用gets

动词搭配 (Verb Collocations).tips: take=拿走/花费/坐（车）/吃药/拍照；get=得到/变得/到达/起床。It takes sb time to do sth=花某人时间做某事。

介词搭配 (Preposition Collocations).name: 常见介词固定搭配
介词搭配 (Preposition Collocations).plainLanguage: 英语中很多动词/形容词和特定介词搭配，需要死记。比如be good at（擅长）、be interested in（对...感兴趣）、look forward to（期待）、be proud of（为...骄傲）等。
rules: be + 形容词 + 介词：be good at, be interested in, be afraid of, be proud of, be famous for
动词 + 介词：look for（寻找）, look after（照顾）, depend on（依赖）, belong to（属于）, suffer from（遭受）
名词 + 介词：reason for, answer to, key to, solution to, interest in
介词后必须接名词/代词/动名词（doing）
固定搭配中的介词不能用其他介词替换

examples.en: She is good at math.
examples.cn: 她擅长数学。

examples.en: I'm interested in reading.
examples.cn: 我对阅读感兴趣。

examples.en: We are looking forward to seeing you.
examples.cn: 我们期待见到你。

examples.en: He is proud of his son.
examples.cn: 他为儿子骄傲。

examples.en: The key to success is hard work.
examples.cn: 成功的关键是努力。

commonMistakes.wrong: She is good in math.
commonMistakes.correct: She is good at math.
commonMistakes.reason: be good at是固定搭配，用at不用in

commonMistakes.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you.
commonMistakes.correct: I'm looking forward to seeing you.
commonMistakes.reason: look forward to中的to是介词，后接动名词seeing

commonMistakes.wrong: He is proud for his son.
commonMistakes.correct: He is proud of his son.
commonMistakes.reason: be proud of是固定搭配，用of不用for

介词搭配 (Preposition Collocations).tips: 介词搭配必须死记！常见：good at, interested in, afraid of, proud of, famous for, look for, depend on, key to, reason for。介词后接doing！

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).name: get短语动词
短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: get加上不同的介词/副词就有不同的意思：get up=起床，get on=上车/进展，get off=下车，get over=克服，get along with=相处。这些必须记！
rules: get up：起床
get on：上车（公交/火车）；进展
get off：下车
get over：克服/恢复
get along with：与...相处
get rid of：摆脱/除掉
get in：进入/到达
get away：逃跑

examples.en: I get up at 6 every morning.
examples.cn: 我每天早上六点起床。

examples.en: Get on the bus quickly.
examples.cn: 快上公交车。

examples.en: Get off at the next stop.
examples.cn: 下一站下车。

examples.en: She can't get over the shock.
examples.cn: 她无法从震惊中恢复。

examples.en: I get along well with my classmates.
examples.cn: 我和同学相处融洽。

commonMistakes.wrong: I get on the bus at 6 every morning.
commonMistakes.correct: I get up at 6 every morning.
commonMistakes.reason: 起床用get up，不是get on（get on是上车）

commonMistakes.wrong: I get well along with my classmates.
commonMistakes.correct: I get along well with my classmates.
commonMistakes.reason: get along with是固定搭配，well放在along后面

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: get up=起床，get on/off=上车/下车，get over=克服，get along with=相处。搭配不同意思完全不同，必须记！

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).name: take短语动词
短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: take加上不同的介词/副词也有不同意思：take off=起飞/脱下，take after=长得像，take up=开始从事，take over=接管，take down=记下。
rules: take off：起飞/脱下（衣服）
take after：长得像（父母/祖辈）
take up：开始从事/占据（时间/空间）
take over：接管/接手
take down：记下/拿下
take place：发生/举行
take part in：参加

examples.en: The plane took off on time.
examples.cn: 飞机准时起飞了。

examples.en: She takes after her mother.
examples.cn: 她长得像她妈妈。

examples.en: I decided to take up tennis.
examples.cn: 我决定开始打网球。

examples.en: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
examples.cn: 会议明天举行。

examples.en: He took down the notes carefully.
examples.cn: 他仔细记笔记。

commonMistakes.wrong: The plane took up on time.
commonMistakes.correct: The plane took off on time.
commonMistakes.reason: 起飞用take off，不是take up（take up=开始从事）

commonMistakes.wrong: She takes off her mother.
commonMistakes.correct: She takes after her mother.
commonMistakes.reason: 长得像用take after，不是take off（take off=起飞/脱衣服）

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: take off=起飞/脱衣，take after=像，take up=从事/占据，take over=接管，take place=发生。相似短语意思差别大！

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).name: put短语动词
短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: put加上不同介词/副词：put on=穿上/上演，put off=推迟，put up=搭建/举起/张贴，put down=放下/写下，put away=收起来。
rules: put on：穿上/戴上/上演
put off：推迟/延期
put up：搭建/举起/张贴/留宿
put down：放下/写下
put away：把...收起来
put out：扑灭/伸出
put up with：忍受/容忍

commonMistakes.wrong: Put off your coat. It's cold.
commonMistakes.correct: Put on your coat. It's cold.
commonMistakes.reason: 穿上衣服用put on，不是put off（put off=推迟）

commonMistakes.wrong: The meeting was put on.
commonMistakes.correct: The meeting was put off.
commonMistakes.reason: 推迟会议用put off，不是put on（put on=穿上/上演）

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: put on=穿上，put off=推迟，put up=搭/举/贴，put down=放下/写下，put away=收起，put up with=忍受。

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: look加上不同介词/副词：look for=寻找，look after=照顾，look at=看，look up=查阅/抬头看，look forward to=期待，look out=小心/当心，look into=调查。
rules: look for：寻找（还没找到）
look after：照顾/照料
look at：看...
look up：查阅（字典）/抬头看
look forward to：期待（后接doing）
look out：小心/当心
look into：调查/研究
look down upon/on：看不起
look up to：仰慕/尊敬

examples.en: I'm looking for my keys.

commonMistakes.wrong: I'm looking forward to see you.
commonMistakes.correct: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: look for=找，look after=照顾，look up=查阅，look forward to=期待（接doing），look out=小心，look into=调查。

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).name: bring/call/carry短语动词
短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: bring加上不同介词/副词意思不同：bring about=引起，bring up=抚养，bring in=引进。call的搭配也多：call on=拜访，call up=打电话，call for=需要，call off=取消。carry有carry on=继续，carry out=执行。这些都要背！
rules: bring about：引起/导致
bring up：抚养/养育/提出（话题）
bring in：引进/赚得（收入）
call on：拜访（某人）/号召
call up：打电话/使回忆起
call for：需要/要求
call off：取消
carry on：继续/进行
carry out：执行/实施

examples.en: The new policy brought about great changes.
examples.cn: 新政策引起了巨大变化。

examples.en: She was brought up by her grandmother.
examples.cn: 她由奶奶抚养长大。

examples.en: Let's call on our teacher tomorrow.
examples.cn: 我们明天去拜访老师吧。

examples.en: The meeting was called off due to the storm.

examples.en: We must carry out the plan immediately.

commonMistakes.wrong: The game was called out due to rain.
commonMistakes.correct: The game was called off due to rain.
commonMistakes.reason: 取消用call off，不是call out

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: bring about=引起，bring up=抚养，call on=拜访，call up=打电话，call for=需要，call off=取消，carry on=继续，carry out=执行。

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).name: come/go/turn短语动词
短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).plainLanguage: come的搭配：come across=偶遇，come up with=想出，come true=实现。go的搭配：go on=继续，go over=复习，go through=经历。turn的搭配：turn on=打开，turn off=关掉，turn out=结果是。这些都是高频短语，必须记住！
rules: come across：偶遇/偶然发现
come up with：想出/提出（主意）
come true：实现（梦想）
go on：继续/发生
go over：复习/仔细检查
go through：经历/通过
turn on：打开（电器）
turn off：关闭（电器）
turn out：结果是/证明为
turn into：变成

examples.en: I came across an old photo yesterday.
examples.cn: 我昨天偶然发现了一张老照片。

examples.en: He came up with a good idea.
examples.cn: 他想出了一个好主意。

examples.en: His dream has come true.
examples.cn: 他的梦想实现了。

examples.en: Please turn off the lights before you leave.

examples.en: It turned out that he was right.
examples.cn: 结果证明他是对的。

commonMistakes.wrong: His dream came real.
commonMistakes.correct: His dream came true.
commonMistakes.reason: 梦想实现用come true，是固定搭配，不能用come real

commonMistakes.wrong: He came up a good idea.
commonMistakes.correct: He came up with a good idea.
commonMistakes.reason: 想出主意是come up with，不能漏掉with

短语动词 (Phrasal Verbs).tips: come across=偶遇，come up with=想出，come true=实现，go on=继续，go over=复习，turn on/off=开关，turn out=结果是，turn into=变成。

固定句式 (Fixed Sentence Patterns).name: 常见固定句式
固定句式 (Fixed Sentence Patterns).plainLanguage: 英语有些句型是固定的模板，往里填词就行。比如'花某人时间做某事'是It takes sb time to do sth；'...的原因是...'是The reason why...is that...；'做某事没用'是It is no use doing sth。记住这些模板，写作文超好用！
rules: It takes sb + 时间 + to do sth：花某人多少时间做某事
The reason why...is that...：...的原因是...
It is no use doing sth：做某事是没用的（后接动名词）
There is no doubt that...：毫无疑问...
It is no wonder that...：难怪...
It happens that.../Sb happens to do...：碰巧...
The + 比较级..., the + 比较级...：越...越...

examples.en: It takes me two hours to finish my homework every day.
examples.cn: 我每天花两小时完成作业。

examples.en: The reason why he was late is that he missed the bus.
examples.cn: 他迟到的原因是他错过了公交车。

examples.en: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
examples.cn: 覆水难收。（做某事是没用的）

examples.en: There is no doubt that he is the best candidate.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问他是最佳候选人。

examples.en: It is no wonder that she passed the exam. She studied hard.
examples.cn: 难怪她通过了考试。她学习很努力。

commonMistakes.wrong: It takes me two hours finishing my homework.
commonMistakes.correct: It takes me two hours to finish my homework.
commonMistakes.reason: It takes sb time to do sth中用不定式to finish，不用动名词finishing

commonMistakes.wrong: The reason why he was late is because he missed the bus.
commonMistakes.correct: The reason why he was late is that he missed the bus.
commonMistakes.reason: The reason why...is that...句式中用that引导表语从句，不能用because（reason和because语义重复）

commonMistakes.wrong: It is no use to cry over spilt milk.
commonMistakes.correct: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
commonMistakes.reason: It is no use后接动名词crying，不接不定式to cry

固定句式 (Fixed Sentence Patterns).tips: 固定句式模板：It takes sb time to do（花时间）/ The reason why...is that（原因是）/ It is no use doing（没用）/ There is no doubt that（毫无疑问）。填词即可用！
